title: From Heterogeneous Firms to Heterogeneous Trade Elasticities: The Aggregate Implications of Firm Export Decisions
abstract: We measure the role of firm heterogeneity in counterfactual predictions of monopolistic competition trade models without parametric restrictions on the distribution of firm fundamentals. We show that two bilateral elasticity functions are sufficient to nonparametrically compute the counterfactual aggregate impact of trade shocks, and recover changes in economic fundamentals from observed data. These functions are identified from two semiparametric gravity equations governing the impact of bilateral trade costs on the extensive and intensive margins of firm-level exports. Applying our methodology, we estimate elasticity functions that imply an impact of trade costs on trade flows that falls when more firms serve a market because of smaller extensive margin responses. Compared to a baseline where elasticities are constant, firm heterogeneity amplifies both the gains from trade in countries with more exporter firms and the welfare gains of European market integration in 2003-2012.
title_cn: 从异质性企业到异质性贸易弹性：企业出口决策的总量含义
abstract_cn: 我们衡量企业异质性在垄断竞争贸易模型反事实预测中的作用，且不对企业基本面的分布施加参数限制。我们证明，两个双边弹性函数足以非参数地计算贸易冲击的反事实总量影响，并从观测数据中恢复经济基本面的变化。这两个函数由两个半参数引力方程识别，这些方程刻画双边贸易成本对企业层面出口的扩展边际和集约边际的影响。应用我们的方法，我们估计的弹性函数表明，当更多企业服务于某一市场时，贸易成本对贸易流量的影响会下降，因为扩展边际反应更小。与弹性为常数的基准情形相比，企业异质性既放大了出口企业更多的国家的贸易收益，也放大了2003—2012年欧洲市场一体化的福利收益。

title: How New Products Enter Markets: Social Networks, Consumer Imports, and Retailer Learning
abstract: This paper studies how new varieties enter markets and become locally available. We provide causal evidence of demand externalities that operate in two steps. First, information about new varieties diffuses directly through real-world social ties among consumers. Second, early purchases generate an indirect spillover to firms: local retailers learn from “pioneer” consumers which new varieties are most likely to succeed and adjust their product offerings accordingly. We study this process in the context of direct-to-consumer imports. Using customs records on individuals’ purchases matched to population-wide social networks, international migrant links, and retailer catchment areas, we document economically meaningful demand externalities. Product-specific expenditure shocks abroad transmit through migrant networks and shift which varieties consumers purchase. Leveraging these shocks as a plausibly exogenous source of local demand variation, we show strong peer effects: prior purchases by close neighbors, coworkers, or friends increase an individual’s likelihood of purchasing the same variety, especially for premium and visible goods. We leverage this result to identify an indirect spillover from consumers to firms: retailers are more likely to add a variety to their assortment when it becomes popular among consumers in their catchment area. Combining the instrument with linked consumer–retailer data and a self-conducted retailer survey, we show that this response reflects learning about latent demand for varieties not yet stocked locally. Together, social diffusion and retailer learning generate demand multipliers that reshape local product availability and expand access to global variety.
title_cn: 新产品如何进入市场：社会网络、消费者进口与零售商学习
abstract_cn: 本文研究新品种如何进入市场并在当地变得可及。我们提供了需求外部性的因果证据，该外部性分两步发挥作用。第一，关于新品种的信息通过消费者之间现实世界的社会联系直接扩散。第二，早期购买会对企业产生间接溢出：本地零售商从“先驱”消费者那里了解到哪些新品种最有可能成功，并据此调整其产品供给。我们在直接面向消费者的进口背景下研究这一过程。利用与全人口社会网络、国际移民联系和零售商服务区域相匹配的个人购买海关记录，我们记录了具有经济意义的需求外部性。国外产品特定的支出冲击通过移民网络传导，并改变消费者购买哪些品种。将这些冲击作为本地需求变化的可信外生来源，我们展示了强烈的同伴效应：近邻、同事或朋友此前的购买会提高个人购买同一品种的可能性，尤其是对高端和可见商品而言。我们利用这一结果识别从消费者到企业的间接溢出：当某一品种在零售商服务区域的消费者中变得流行时，零售商更有可能将该品种加入其产品组合。将工具变量与消费者—零售商关联数据和自行开展的零售商调查相结合，我们表明这一反应反映了对当地尚未备货品种的潜在需求的学习。社会扩散与零售商学习共同产生需求乘数，重塑本地产品可及性并扩大对全球品种的获取。

title: Optimal Flood Insurance in a Second-Best World: Fiscal Spillovers, Reclassification Risk, and Moral Hazard
abstract: Intensifying climate change makes protection against natural disaster risk – either through ex ante insurance or ex post aid – a first-order public policy issue. Flood risk protection in the U.S. traditionally featured ex post aid through FEMA and heavily subsidized insurance through the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). In an effort to correct subsidy-induced overbuilding and under-mitigation in flood-prone areas, the NFIP recently moved to actuarially fair insurance premiums. But this change has two unintended consequences: a fiscal spillover onto FEMA disaster aid as insurance coverage declines in flood-prone areas, and household exposure to uninsurable reclassification risk from uncertain climate projections. We develop a model of optimal flood insurance that incorporates the static and dynamic tradeoffs of subsidizing premiums. We then use a variety of identification strategies and data to estimate the five key parameters needed to implement this model. We find that the fiscal spillover and reclassification risk protection benefits significantly outweigh the moral hazard costs, and that the optimal subsidy to flood insurance is 51%, comparable to the level of subsidization before the recent reform.
title_cn: 次优世界中的最优洪水保险：财政外溢、重新分类风险与道德风险
abstract_cn: 气候变化加剧使自然灾害风险防护——无论是通过事前保险还是事后援助——成为首要的公共政策问题。美国的洪水风险防护传统上以事后援助（通过FEMA）和高度补贴的保险（通过国家洪水保险计划，NFIP）为特征。为纠正补贴引致的洪泛区过度建设与减灾投入不足，NFIP近期转向精算公平的保险费率。但这一变化带来两个非意图后果：随着洪泛区保险覆盖率下降，财政外溢至FEMA灾害援助；以及家庭面临来自不确定气候预测的不可保险的重新分类风险。我们构建了一个最优洪水保险模型，纳入补贴保费所涉及的静态与动态权衡。随后，我们运用多种识别策略和数据，估计了实施该模型所需的五个关键参数。我们发现，财政外溢与重新分类风险防护收益显著超过道德风险成本，且洪水保险的最优补贴为51%，与近期改革前的补贴水平相当。

title: Can Gifted Education Help Higher-Ability Boys from Disadvantaged Backgrounds?
abstract: Boys are less likely than girls to enter college, a gap often attributed to differences in noncognitive skills. We study how being classified as gifted – determined by having an IQ score of ≥116 – affects college entry for disadvantaged children in a large urban school district. We find increases of around 50 percent for marginally eligible boys, but only small effects for girls. There are also large effects for boys (but not girls) on course-taking and grades in middle and high school with no effects on standardized tests scores. These patterns suggest that gifted services raise the non-cognitive skills of underachieving boys, leading to gains in educational attainment.
title_cn: 英才教育能否帮助弱势背景的高能力男孩？
abstract_cn: 男孩进入大学的可能性低于女孩，这一差距常被归因于非认知技能的差异。我们研究在一个大型城市学区中，被认定为资优——认定标准为智商分数≥116——如何影响弱势儿童的大学入学。我们发现，对于处于资格边缘的男孩，大学入学率提高约50%，但对女孩的影响很小。在初中和高中的选课与成绩方面，男孩（而非女孩）也受到较大影响，但对标准化考试成绩没有影响。这些模式表明，资优服务提升了表现不佳男孩的非认知技能，从而带来教育获得的提升。

title: Robust Aggregation of Correlated Information
abstract: Decisions are typically made by drawing on multiple sources of information, yet the correlation among these sources is often hard to assess. We study robustly optimal strategies—those that maximize the worst-case payoff guarantee across all correlation structures. With two states and two actions, the robustly optimal strategy is strikingly simple: use only the best information source and ignore the rest. With more actions, a robustly optimal strategy decomposes the problem into local comparisons and assigns each comparison to the source that is best at that comparison. With more states, the same specialization logic survives through a concavification characterization: the decision problem is decomposed into payoff-relevant components, and each component is assigned to its best source. These results offer a new rationale for why ignoring information can be optimal and highlight the benefit of using specialized information sources when correlations are ambiguous.
title_cn: 相关信息的稳健加总
abstract_cn: 决策通常依赖多个信息来源，但这些来源之间的相关性往往难以评估。我们研究稳健最优策略，即在所有相关结构下最大化最坏情形收益保证的策略。在两状态、两行动的情形下，稳健最优策略极为简单：只使用最佳信息来源，忽略其余来源。在行动更多时，稳健最优策略将问题分解为局部比较，并将每一项比较分配给在该比较上表现最佳的信息来源。在状态更多时，同样的专业化逻辑通过凹化刻画得以保留：决策问题被分解为与收益相关的组成部分，每个组成部分被分配给其最佳信息来源。这些结果为为何忽略信息可能是最优的提供了新的解释，并凸显了在相关性模糊时使用专业化信息来源的益处。

title: When Should We (Not) Interpret Linear IV Estimands as LATE?
abstract: In this paper I revisit the interpretation of the linear instrumental variables (IV) estimand as a weighted average of conditional local average treatment effects (LATEs). I focus on a situation in which additional covariates are required for identification while the reduced-form and first-stage regressions may be misspecified due to an implicit homogeneity restriction on the effects of the instrument. I show that the weights on some conditional LATEs are negative and the IV estimand is no longer interpretable as a causal effect under a weaker version of monotonicity, i.e. when there are compliers but no defiers at some covariate values and defiers but no compliers elsewhere. The problem of negative weights disappears in the interacted specification of Angrist and Imbens (I1995), which avoids misspecification and seems to be underused in applied work. I illustrate my findings in an application to the causal effects of pretrial detention on case outcomes. In this setting, I reject the stronger version of monotonicity, demonstrate that the interacted instruments are sufficiently strong for consistent estimation using the jackknife methodology, and present several estimates that are economically and statistically different, depending on whether the interacted instruments are used.
title_cn: 我们何时应（不）将线性IV估计量解释为LATE？
abstract_cn: 本文重新审视将线性工具变量（IV）估计量解释为条件局部平均处理效应（LATE）加权平均的做法。我关注的情形是：识别需要额外的协变量，而简化式与第一阶段回归可能因对工具变量效应施加了隐含的同质性限制而出现错误设定。我表明，在此情形下部分条件 LATE 的权重为负，且在较弱版本的单调性下——即某些协变量取值处存在依从者但无违抗者、而另一些取值处存在违抗者但无依从者——IV 估计量不再可解释为因果效应。负权重问题在 Angrist 和 Imbens（1995）的交互设定中消失，该设定避免了错误设定，但在应用研究中似乎使用不足。我以审前羁押对案件结果的因果效应为应用场景来说明上述发现。在该设定中，我拒绝了较强版本的单调性，证明交互工具变量在使用 jackknife 方法进行一致估计时足够强，并给出了若干在经济和统计上存在差异的估计结果，其差异取决于是否使用交互工具变量。

title: Welfare and the Act of Choosing
abstract: The standard revealed-preference approach to welfare economics encounters fundamental difficulties when the act of choosing directly affects welfare through emotions such as guilt, pride, and anxiety. We address this problem by developing an approach that redefines consumption bundles in terms of the sensations they produce, and measures welfare by blending choice-based methods with self-reported well-being techniques. In applications to classic social preferences paradigms, our approach shows that standard revealed-preference methods, including those that exploit choices over menus, mismeasure welfare because preferences depend on choice sets, while self-reported happiness and satisfaction are not sufficient statistics for welfare.
title_cn: 福利与选择行为
abstract_cn: 福利经济学的标准显示性偏好方法在以下情形中会遇到根本性困难：选择行为本身会通过内疚、自豪和焦虑等情绪直接影响福利。我们通过发展一种方法来解决这一问题：该方法以选择所产生的感受来重新定义消费束，并将基于选择的方法与自我报告的幸福感技术相结合来度量福利。在应用于经典社会偏好范式时，我们的方法表明，标准的显示性偏好方法——包括那些利用菜单选择的方法——会错误地度量福利，因为偏好依赖于选择集；而自我报告的幸福感和满意度并不是福利的充分统计量。

title: A Theory of Economic Coercion and Fragmentation
abstract: Hegemonic powers, like the United States and China, exert influence on other countries by threatening the suspension or alteration of financial and trade relationships. Mechanisms that generate gains from integration, such as external economies of scale and specialization, also increase the hegemon's power because in equilibrium they make other relationships poor substitutes for those with a global hegemon. Other countries can implement economic security policies to shape their economies in order to insulate themselves from undue foreign pressure. Countries considering these policies face a tradeoff between gains from trade and economic security. While an individual country can make itself better off, uncoordinated attempts by multiple countries to limit their dependency on the hegemon via economic security policies lead to inefficient fragmentation of the global financial and trade system. We study financial services as a leading application both as tools of coercion and an industry with strong strategic complementarities. We estimate that U.S. geoeconomic power relies on financial services, while Chinese power relies on manufacturing. Since power is nonlinear and increases disproportionally as the hegemon approaches controlling the entire supply of a sectoral input, we estimate that much economic security could be achieved with little overall fragmentation by diversifying the input sources of key sectors controlled by the hegemons.
title_cn: 经济胁迫与碎片化理论
abstract_cn: 霸权国家（如美国和中国）通过威胁暂停或改变金融与贸易关系来对其他国施加影响。那些从一体化中产生收益的机制，例如外部规模经济和专业化，也会增强霸权国的权力，因为在均衡中这些机制使其他国家与全球霸权国之外的关系成为较差的替代品。其他国家可以实施经济安全政策来塑造本国经济，从而与不当的外国压力隔绝。考虑这些政策的国家面临贸易收益与经济安全之间的权衡。尽管单个国家可以使自身状况改善，但多个国家通过经济安全政策限制对霸权国依赖的不协调尝试，会导致全球金融与贸易体系的低效碎片化。我们以金融服务作为主要应用场景进行研究，既将其视为强制工具，也将其视为具有强策略互补性的行业。我们估计，美国的地缘经济权力依赖金融服务，而中国的权力依赖制造业。由于权力是非线性的，并且当霸权国接近控制某一部门投入品的全部供给时权力会不成比例地上升，我们估计，通过分散由霸权国控制的关键部门的投入品来源，可以在整体碎片化程度很低的情况下实现很大的经济安全。

title: Closing Ranks: Organized Labor and Immigration
abstract: This paper shows that immigration fostered the emergence of organized labor in the United States. I digitize archival records to assemble the first county-level dataset on historical U.S. union membership and use a shift-share instrument to isolate a plausibly exogenous labor supply shock induced by immigration, between 1900 and 1920. Counties with higher immigration experienced increases in union presence, the number of union branches, the share of unionized workers, and the number of union members per branch. These effects were more pronounced among skilled workers, particularly in counties more exposed to labor competition from immigrants, and in areas with more negative attitudes toward immigrants. The evidence is consistent with existing workers unionizing in response to immigration, driven by both economic and social motivations. These findings highlight a novel driver of unionization in the early 20th-century United States and reveal an unexplored consequence of immigration: the development of institutions aimed at protecting workers’ status in the labor market, with effects that persist to the present.
title_cn: 缩小队伍：工会与移民
abstract_cn: 本文表明，移民促进了美国有组织劳工的兴起。我通过数字化档案记录，构建了首个关于美国历史工会会员人数的县级数据集，并使用移动份额工具变量分离出1900年至1920年间由移民引发的、可视为外生的劳动力供给冲击。移民水平更高的县，工会存在感、工会分支数量、工会化工人占比以及每个分支的工会会员人数均有所增加。这些效应在技术工人中更为明显，在受移民劳动力竞争影响更大的县以及对移民态度更负面的地区尤为突出。证据与现有工人因移民而加入工会相一致，其动机既包括经济因素也包括社会因素。这些发现凸显了20世纪初美国工会化的一个新驱动因素，并揭示了移民的一个尚未被探讨的后果：旨在保护工人在劳动力市场中地位的制度得以发展，其影响延续至今。

title: Firm Heterogeneity and the Impact of Immigration: Evidence from German Establishments
abstract: We use a detailed establishment-level dataset from Germany to document a new dimension of firm heterogeneity: large firms spend a higher share of their wage bill on immigrants than small firms. We show analytically that ignoring this heterogeneity in the immigrant share leads to biased estimates of the welfare gains from immigration. To do so, we set up and estimate a model where heterogeneous firms choose their immigrant share and then use it to quantify the welfare effects of an increase in the number of immigrants in Germany. Two new adjustment mechanisms arise under firm heterogeneity. First, native workers reallocate across firms, which mitigates the competition effect between immigrants and natives in the labor market. Second, the gains are largely concentrated among the largest and most productive employers, which induces an additional aggregate productivity gain. If we ignore the heterogeneity in the immigrant share across firms, we would underestimate the welfare gains of native workers by 11%.
title_cn: 企业异质性与移民的影响：来自德国企业的证据
abstract_cn: 我们使用德国详细的企业层面数据集，记录企业异质性的一个新维度：大企业工资总额中用于移民的份额高于小企业。我们通过解析证明，忽略移民份额上的这种异质性会导致对移民福利收益的估计出现偏差。为此，我们构建并估计了一个模型，其中异质性企业选择其移民份额，然后利用该模型量化德国移民数量增加所带来的福利效应。在企业异质性下出现了两个新的调整机制。第一，本地劳动者在企业之间重新配置，这缓解了移民与本地劳动者在劳动力市场上的竞争效应。第二，收益在很大程度上集中于规模最大、生产率最高的雇主，这带来了额外的总量生产率收益。如果我们忽略企业间移民份额的异质性，就会将本地劳动者的福利收益低估 11%。

title: Buying Data from Consumers: The Impact of Monitoring in U.S. Auto Insurance
abstract: New technologies have enabled firms to elicit granular behavioral data from consumers in exchange for lower prices and better experiences. This data can mitigate asymmetric information and moral hazard, but it may also increase firms' market power if kept proprietary. We study a voluntary monitoring program by a major U.S. auto insurer, in which drivers accept short-term tracking in exchange for potential discounts on future premiums. Using a proprietary dataset matched with competitor price menus, we document that safer drivers self-select into monitoring, and those who opt in become yet 30% safer while monitored. Using an equilibrium model of consumer choice and firm pricing for insurance and monitoring, we find that the monitoring program generates large profit and welfare gains. However, large demand frictions hurt monitoring adoption, forcing the firm to offer large discounts to induce opt-in while preventing the unmonitored pool from unraveling given the competitive environment.A counterfactual policy requiring the firm to make monitoring data public would thus further reduce the firm's incentive to elicit monitoring data, leading to less monitoring and lower consumer welfare in equilibrium.
title_cn: 从消费者处购买数据：美国汽车保险中监测的影响
abstract_cn: 新技术使企业能够以更低的价格和更好的体验为交换，获取消费者的细粒度行为数据。这些数据可以缓解信息不对称和道德风险，但如果企业将其专有化，也可能增强企业的市场势力。我们研究美国一家大型汽车保险公司实施的自愿监测计划，在该计划中，驾驶员接受短期跟踪，以换取未来保费的可能折扣。利用与竞争对手价格菜单相匹配的专有数据集，我们发现，更安全的驾驶员会自我选择进入监测，而选择加入者在被监测期间变得更加安全，幅度达30%。利用一个关于保险与监测的消费者选择和企业定价的均衡模型，我们发现该监测计划带来了可观的利润和福利收益。然而，较大的需求摩擦损害了监测的采用，迫使企业提供大幅折扣以诱导选择加入，同时在竞争环境下防止未被监测群体出现逆向选择式的瓦解。因此，一项要求企业公开监测数据的反事实政策将进一步降低企业获取监测数据的激励，导致均衡中监测减少、消费者福利下降。

title: The Demand for Mobility: Evidence from an Experiment with Uber Riders
abstract: Optimal transportation policies depend on demand elasticities that interact across modes and vary across the population, but understanding how and why these elasticities vary has been an empirical challenge. Using an experiment with Uber in Egypt, we randomly assign large price discounts for transport services over a 3 month period to examine: (1) the demand for ride-hailing services, (2) the demand for total mobility (km/week), and (3) its contributions to external costs (e.g.congestion).A 50% discount more than quadruples Uber usage and induces an increase of nearly 49% in total mobility. These effects are stronger for women, who are less mobile at baseline and perceive public transit as unsafe. Technology-induced reductions in the price of ridehailing services could generate substantial benefits to users (4.3% of GDP) that would be accompanied by considerable increases in external costs (1% of GDP), with benefits accruing to the most affluent and costs being borne by the entire population.
title_cn: 出行需求：来自 Uber 乘客实验的证据
abstract_cn: 最优交通政策取决于在不同交通方式之间相互作用、并随人群而变化的需​​求弹性，但理解这些弹性如何以及为何变化一直是一个实证难题。我们利用在埃及与 Uber 开展的一项实验，在 3 个月期间随机分配大幅的交通服务价格折扣，以考察：(1) 网约车服务的需求，(2) 总出行需求（公里/周），以及 (3) 其对外部成本（如拥堵）的贡献。50% 的折扣使 Uber 使用量增加逾四倍，并使总出行量增加近 49%。这些效应在女性中更强，因为女性在基线时的出行更少，并认为公共交通不安全。技术带来的网约车服务价格下降可为用户带来可观收益（占 GDP 的 4.3%），同时伴随外部成本的大幅增加（占 GDP 的 1%），收益归于最富裕人群，而成本由全体人口承担。

title: The Direct and Indirect Effects of Online Job Search Advice
abstract: We study how online job search advice affects job search behavior and labor market outcomes of unemployed workers. In a large-scale field experiment embedded in the online platform of the Danish public employment service, we provide job seekers with vacancy information and occupational recommendations. Using a two-stage randomized design with regionally varying treatment intensities, we examine both direct effects of advice and treatment spillovers. We find that advice significantly increases employment and earnings when provided to a limited share of job seekers. As treatment intensity rises, these effects diminish and eventually disappear. The decline is driven by negative spillovers among treated job seekers, consistent with increased congestion in the occupations toward which job seekers redirect their search. Spillover effects on untreated job seekers are heterogeneous and depend on how advice alters occupation-specific competition in local labor markets.
title_cn: 在线求职建议的直接效应与间接效应
abstract_cn: 我们研究在线求职建议如何影响失业劳动者的求职行为和劳动力市场结果。在一项嵌入丹麦公共就业服务在线平台的大规模田野实验中，我们向求职者提供空缺职位信息和职业建议。采用处理强度随地区变化的两阶段随机设计，我们考察建议的直接效应和处理溢出效应。我们发现，当建议仅提供给有限比例的求职者时，建议显著提高了就业和收入。随着处理强度上升，这些效应减弱并最终消失。这一下降由受处理求职者之间的负向溢出效应驱动，这与求职者将搜索转向的职业中拥挤程度上升相一致。对未受处理求职者的溢出效应具有异质性，取决于建议如何改变当地劳动力市场中特定职业的竞争状况。

title: Quality Regulation and Competition: Evidence from Pharmaceutical Markets
abstract: Quality regulation seeks to ensure quality and foster competition by reducing vertical differentiation, but it may also have adverse effects on market structure. We study this trade-off in the context of pharmaceutical bioequivalence, which is the primary quality standard for generic drugs. By exploiting the introduction of bioequivalence in Chile, we find that stronger regulation reduced the number of drugs in the market by 18% and increased average paid prices by 13%. We estimate a model of drug entry, certification, and demand to study how drug quality, aversion to generics, and certification costs shape the equilibrium effects of quality regulation. We find that quality regulation increased demand for generic drugs by resolving asymmetric information and reducing aversion to unbranded generics, which induced the entry of high-quality drugs in place of low-quality drugs. Consumer welfare increased despite higher prices and a lower number of firms. We compare minimum quality standards with alternative designs of quality regulation, including quality disclosure.
title_cn: 质量监管与竞争：来自药品市场的证据
abstract_cn: 质量监管旨在通过减少纵向差异化来确保质量并促进竞争，但也可能对市场结构产生不利影响。我们以药品生物等效性为背景研究这一权衡，生物等效性是仿制药的主要质量标准。利用智利引入生物等效性规定的契机，我们发现更严格的监管使市场中的药品数量减少了18%，并使平均实付价格上升了13%。我们估计了一个包含药品进入、认证和需求的模型，以研究药品质量、对仿制药的厌恶以及认证成本如何塑造质量监管的均衡效应。我们发现，质量监管通过缓解信息不对称和降低对无品牌仿制药的厌恶增加了对仿制药的需求，进而引致高质量药品进入并替代低质量药品。尽管价格上升且企业数量减少，消费者福利仍有所提高。我们将最低质量标准与质量监管的其他设计（包括质量披露）进行了比较。

title: Are Markups Too High? Competition, Strategic Innovation, and Industry Dynamics
abstract: To study competition, innovation, and industry dynamics that arise as a result of their interaction, we develop a new oligopolistic general-equilibrium Schumpeterian growth model. This model ties together the endogenous growth, oligopolistic competition, and dynamic industrial organization literatures in a single unified framework. Within each industry, there are an endogenously determined number of large firms (“superstars”) that compete à la Cournot and a continuum of small firms which collectively constitute a competitive fringe. Firms dynamically choose their innovation strategies, cognizant of other firms’ choices, and their entry and exit are endogenous. The model is consistent with the macroeconomic trends observed in the US since the 1970s, such as the domination of industries by a small number of superstar firms, the rise of markups, market concentration, profits, and R&D spending, and the decline in business dynamism, productivity growth, and the labour share. It replicates the empirical relationship between innovation and competition within and across industries. As an application, we estimate the model to disentangle the effects of separate mechanisms on the structural transition observed in the US, which yields striking results: (1) While the increase in the average markup causes a significant static welfare loss, this loss is overshadowed by the dynamic welfare gains from increased innovation in response to higher profit opportunities. (2) The increasing costs of innovation are found to be the primary determinant of lacklustre productivity growth, i.e. ideas are getting harder to find.
title_cn: 加成定价是否过高？竞争、策略性创新与行业动态
abstract_cn: 为研究竞争、创新及其相互作用所引致的产业动态，我们构建了一个新的寡头垄断一般均衡熊彼特增长模型。该模型将内生增长、寡头竞争与动态产业组织文献整合于单一统一框架之中。在每个产业内，存在内生决定数量的大型企业（“超级明星企业”）按古诺方式竞争，以及由小企业连续统构成的竞争性边缘。企业在考虑其他企业选择的基础上动态选择创新策略，其进入与退出均为内生。该模型与美国自20世纪70年代以来观察到的宏观趋势相一致，包括少数超级明星企业对产业的支配、加成率、市场集中度、利润与R&D支出的上升，以及企业动态、生产率增长与劳动份额的下降。它复现了产业内与产业间创新与竞争之间的经验关系。作为应用，我们估计该模型以分解不同机制对美国所观察到的结构转型的影响，得到了引人注目的结果：（1）尽管平均加成率的上升造成了显著的静态福利损失，但这一损失被因利润机会增加而引致的创新增加所带来的动态福利收益所掩盖。（2）创新成本的上升被发现是生产率增长乏力的主要决定因素，即思想正变得越来越难以发现。

title: The Marginal Propensity to Hire
abstract: When financial constraints bind, firms adjust employment in response to cash flow shocks. A 2010 revaluation of business rates, a UK tax levied on business-occupied properties, implied that similar firms, occupying similar properties in narrow geographical locations, experienced different tax changes. I find that, on average, for every ￡1 of additional cash flow triggered by the tax change, 39 pence were spent on employment, with small and leveraged firms responding the most. I use these findings to discipline a general equilibrium model with firm heterogeneity and financial frictions and quantitatively determine the aggregate effects of a fiscal transfer to firms.
title_cn: 边际雇佣倾向
abstract_cn: 当金融约束具有约束力时，企业会针对现金流冲击调整就业。2010年英国对营业房产税（对营业占用房产征收的一种税）的重新估值意味着，在狭窄地理区域内占用相似房产的相似企业经历了不同的税收变化。我发现，平均而言，税收变化所引发的每1英镑额外现金流中，有39便士用于就业支出，其中小型企业和杠杆化程度较高的企业反应最大。我利用这些发现来校准一个包含企业异质性和金融摩擦的一般均衡模型，并定量确定向企业进行财政转移支付的总量效应。

title: Truth Elicitation in a Nonstrategic Environment
abstract: A principal decides which party deserves a prize. Only the parties observe the state that determines who is deserving. The principal gives each party a text describing the conditions under which that party deserves the prize and asks each to report the state. The parties are nonstrategic. Each activates a known cheating procedure whose outcome depends on the state and on the text. Implementation is achieved if, whenever the parties disagree, the liar is identified by the “one-way cheating principle”: The truthful party is the unique party who could not have produced his story had the rival's story been true. (JEL D82, D91)
title_cn: 非策略性环境中的真相诱导
abstract_cn: 一位委托人决定哪一方应获得奖励。只有各方观察到决定谁应获奖的状态。委托人给每一方一份文本，描述该方在何种条件下应获奖，并要求每一方报告状态。各方均非策略性行事。每一方启动一个已知的作弊程序，其结果取决于状态和文本。若每当各方意见不一致时，说谎者都能通过“单向作弊原则”被识别出来，则实施得以实现：诚实的一方是唯一一个在对手陈述为真的情况下不可能给出自己陈述的一方。（JEL D82、D91）

title: Screening and Segmenting: A Consumer Surplus Perspective
abstract: We analyze consumer surplus when a monopolist can adjust both prices and product qualities across segments, engaging in secondand third-degree price discrimination simultaneously. We characterize the consumer-optimal segmentation and show that it has a striking structure: Consumers with the same value receive the same quality in every segment, though prices differ. Under mild conditions, any segmentation harms consumers if and only if demand is sufficiently more elastic than supply. Hence, potential benefits for consumers depend critically on demand and supply elasticities. These findings have implications for regulatory policy regarding price discrimination and market segmentation. (JEL D42, D83, K21, L12, L15)
title_cn: 筛选与细分：消费者剩余视角
abstract_cn: 我们分析了当垄断者能够同时调整不同细分市场的价格和产品质量、并同时实施二级和三级价格歧视时的消费者剩余。我们刻画了消费者最优的市场细分，并表明其具有一个显著结构：具有相同价值的消费者在每个细分市场中获得相同的质量，尽管价格不同。在温和条件下，任何市场细分都会损害消费者利益，当且仅当需求相对于供给足够富有弹性。因此，消费者可能获得的收益关键取决于需求和供给弹性。这些发现对有关价格歧视和市场细分的监管政策具有启示意义。（JEL D42, D83, K21, L12, L15）

title: Who Marries Whom? The Role of Segregation by Race and Class
abstract: Americans rarely marry outside their race or class group, a pattern with well-documented implications for inequality and intergenerational mobility. Limited exposure may partly explain these low intergroup marriage rates. We instrument for exposure using variation in childhood neighborhoods based on whether other race and class groups had more opposite-sex children of similar age. Exposure increases interclass (high- and low-parent income) marriage but has no detectable effect on interracial (White and Black) marriage. A spatial marriage model predicts that residential segregation—one of many forms of exposure—accounts for more than one-third of marital sorting by class but less than 5 percent by race. (JEL J12, J15, J62, R23)
title_cn: 谁与谁结婚？种族与阶层隔离的作用
abstract_cn: 美国人很少与自身种族或阶层群体之外的人结婚，这一模式对不平等和代际流动的影响已有充分文献记载。接触机会有限可能部分解释了这些较低的群体间通婚率。我们利用童年邻里环境的变化作为接触的工具变量，其依据是其他种族和阶层群体是否有更多年龄相近的异性子女。接触机会增加了跨阶层（父母收入高低不同）婚姻，但对跨种族（白人与黑人）婚姻没有可检测到的影响。一个空间婚姻模型预测，居住隔离——众多接触形式之一——解释了按阶层婚配中超过三分之一的婚姻匹配，但按种族婚配中不足5%。（JEL J12, J15, J62, R23）

title: Taxing Top Wealth: Migration Responses and Their Aggregate Economic Implications
abstract: Using administrative data from Scandinavian countries, we provide evidence on international migration responses to wealth taxes and evaluate their aggregate economic implications. We find significant migration responses among the wealthy: A 1 percentage point increase in the top wealth tax rate decreases the stock of wealthy taxpayers by about 2 percent. A large fraction of the wealthy are business owners, and their businesses are negatively affected by owner out-migration. The aggregate effects are nevertheless modest: The migration responses to a 1 percentage point increase in the top wealth tax rate reduce employment by 0.02 percent, investments by 0.07 percent, and value added by 0.10 percent. (JEL D31, E22, E24, F22, H24, L26, K34)

title: A Model of the Attention Economy: Data, Platforms, and Discovery
abstract: This paper develops a dynamic model of the attention economy featuring two interlinked markets: a product market, where consumers have limited awareness of firms, and an attention market, where platforms attract attention by investing in free services (e.g., social media, streaming, podcasts) and sell targeted ads using data on consumer preferences. The model provides a tractable framework in which platform investment, ad-driven discovery, product demand, and ad revenue are jointly determined. The effects of data and interoperability policies can reverse over time, platform quality may be inefficiently high or low, and the rise of data-rich digital advertising can coincide with a declining ad revenue-to-GDP ratio. (JEL D43, D44, D58, D83, L86, M37)

title: Fighting for Growth: Labor Scarcity and Technological Progress during the British Industrial Revolution
abstract: We establish a link between labor scarcity and the adoption of laborsaving technology in industrializing England. During the Napoleonic Wars, more than 10 percent of the male population served in the armed forces. Where recruitment was heavy, more machines economizing on labor were adopted. Naval recruitment, instrumented by warships' coastal access, provides exogenous variation in labor scarcity and suggests that the link between labor shortages and adoption is causal. Where mechanical skills were abundant, the impact of labor scarcity on adoption appears to be larger. (JEL J24, N13, N43, N63, N73, O14, O31)

title: Social Push and the Direction of Innovation
abstract: What are the implications of unequal access to innovation careers for the direction of innovation and inequality? Leveraging novel linked datasets in the United States and Finland, we document that innovators create products more likely to be purchased by consumers like them in terms of gender, socioeconomic status, and age. Homophily exists both within narrow product categories and across industries and has been stable in recent decades. Incorporating this “social push” channel into a growth model, we estimate that unequal access to innovation careers has a large effect on cost of living inequality and long-run growth. (JEL D63, J16, L26, M13, O31, O33, O47)

title: Racial Promotion Gaps
abstract: We study racial disparities in promotions in a setting in which promotions are formulaic: the US patent office. Using detailed administrative data that allow us to observe who is eligible for promotion when, we document that Black patent examiners experience delays in promotions they are entitled to, slowing their climb to the top of the career ladder by a year and reducing career earnings by 2.5 percent. Institutional features rule out statistical discrimination with accurate priors. Slow promotions even under Black supervisors argue against taste-based animus. Instead, the patterns fit models of belief-based discrimination. (JEL J15, J41, J71, M12, M51, O34)
title_cn: 种族晋升差距

title: Knowledge Spillovers, Competition, and Individual Careers
abstract: Exposure to better peers in the workplace can influence career trajectories through two opposing channels: positively, via knowledge spillovers, and negatively, through competition for advancement. We disentangle these effects by studying untrained labor market entrants and distinguishing between coworkers in the same occupation with whom they are likely to compete versus those with whom they are unlikely to compete. We find robust evidence of persistent knowledge spillovers but also identify countervailing competition effects of comparable magnitude. Both effects are more pronounced for men than for women. title: Retrieval Failures and Consumption Smoothing: A Field Experiment on Seasonal Poverty
abstract: People may fail to recall and use information they already know when making decisions. We empirically investigate whether such “retrieval failures” distort consumption-smoothing behavior among Zambian farmers, who derive their income from one annual harvest and spend it over the course of the year. We document that individuals underestimate upcoming spending by 50%, creating scope for undersaving. To improve recall, we randomize an intervention that prompts people to think through their future expenses associatively in categories—without providing any external information or guidance. Treated individuals increase “remembered” expenses by 36%–60%; as predicted by the memory literature, effects are concentrated among small, irregular, and stochastic items. Immediate spending drops and, six weeks after the intervention, treated households hold 15% higher savings. They subsequently enter the hungry season—the final months of the year when consumption typically declines sharply—with one additional month of savings, leading to a flatter spending profile over the year. Households use the increased savings to self-finance additional farm investment, resulting in a 9% increase in the next year’s crop revenue. We replicate the intervention’s effect on beliefs among low-income Americans, suggesting that retrieval failures generalize across settings and populations.
title_cn: 记忆提取失败与消费平滑：关于季节性贫困的田野实验
abstract_cn: 人们在决策时可能无法回忆并使用自己已经知道的信息。我们实证研究这种“记忆提取失败”是否会扭曲赞比亚农民的消费平滑行为；这些农民的收入来自每年一次的收成，并在一年中逐步支出。我们发现，个体低估了即将发生的支出，幅度达50%，这为储蓄不足创造了空间。为改善记忆提取，我们随机实施了一项干预，促使人们按类别联想式地思考未来支出，而不提供任何外部信息或指导。接受干预者“记得”的支出增加了36%–60%；正如记忆文献所预测的，效应集中在金额小、不规律且随机的项目上。即时支出下降，且在干预六周后，接受干预的家庭持有的储蓄高出15%。随后，他们带着多出一个月的储蓄进入饥饿季节——即一年中消费通常大幅下降的最后几个月——从而使全年支出曲线更为平滑。家庭将增加的储蓄用于自筹额外的农业投资，使次年作物收入增加9%。我们在低收入美国人中复现了该干预对信念的影响，表明记忆提取失败在不同环境和人群中具有普遍性。

title: Monetary Policy Invariance, Hysteresis, and Optimal Inflation
abstract: Standard New Keynesian (NK) models feature an optimal inflation target well below 2%, limited welfare losses from business cycle fluctuations and long-term monetary neutrality. We develop an NK framework with endogenous productivity and downward nominal wage rigidity (DNWR) which challenges these results. The interaction between endogenous growth and DNWR generates asymmetric hysteresis effects on unemployment and R&D. As a consequence, the model features a nonvertical long-run Phillips curve and a trade-off between price distortions and output hysteresis that changes the welfare-maximizing inflation rate to above 2%. Deviations from the optimal target carry welfare costs multiple times those in traditional NK models. Taylor rules that respond to the unemployment rate address more effectively the asymmetric hysteresis in our model. Results are robust to the inclusion of the effective lower bound on interest rates.
title_cn: 货币政策不变性、滞后效应与最优通胀
abstract_cn: 标准新凯恩斯主义（NK）模型的特征是，最优通胀目标远低于2%，经济周期波动带来的福利损失有限，且长期货币中性。我们构建了一个包含内生生产率和向下名义工资刚性（DNWR）的NK框架，该框架对这些结果提出了挑战。内生增长与DNWR之间的相互作用对失业和R&D产生非对称的滞后效应。因此，该模型具有非垂直的长期菲利普斯曲线，以及价格扭曲与产出滞后之间的权衡，这将福利最大化通胀率改变为高于2%。偏离最优目标所带来的福利成本是传统NK模型中的数倍。对失业率作出反应的泰勒规则能更有效地应对我们模型中的非对称滞后。结果在纳入利率有效下限时仍然稳健。

title: The Origin of Risk
abstract: We propose a tractable model in which risk, at both the micro and macro levels, is endogenous and driven by incentives. In the model, each firm chooses the mean and the variance of its productivity process, as well as how it covaries with the productivity of other firms. Aggregate risk arises when firms select productivity processes that are correlated with one another. The theory predicts that larger firms and those with lower markups are less volatile and less correlated with aggregate productivity. We find support for these predictions in the data. Through their impact on risk-taking decisions, distortions such as taxes and markups can make GDP more volatile in equilibrium. In a calibrated version of the model, removing distortions significantly reduces GDP volatility.
title_cn: 风险的起源
abstract_cn: 我们提出一个易处理模型，其中微观和宏观层面的风险都是内生的，并由激励驱动。在该模型中，每家企业选择其生产率过程的均值和方差，以及该过程如何与其他企业的生产率共同变动。当企业选择彼此相关的生产率过程时，总量风险便会产生。该理论预测，规模较大的企业以及加成率较低的企业波动性较小，且与总量生产率的关联性较弱。我们在数据中找到了支持这些预测的证据。通过影响风险承担决策，税收和加成等扭曲可以使均衡状态下的GDP更加波动。在模型的校准版本中，消除扭曲会显著降低GDP波动。

title: Busing to Opportunity? The Impacts of the Metco Voluntary School Desegregation Program on Urban Students of Color
abstract: School assignment policies are a key lever for expanding access to high-performing schools and promoting racial and socioeconomic integration. For over 50 years, the Metropolitan Council for Educational Opportunity (METCO) has bussed students of color from Boston, Massachusetts, to relatively wealthier and predominantly white suburbs. I estimate the effects of attending a high-performing suburban school by comparing applicants who receive enrollment offers with applicants who do not. A two-stage least squares approach exploits waitlist assignment priorities and controls for a rich set of characteristics from birth records and application data. Attending a suburban school boosts math and English test scores, reduces dropout, and increases on-time high school graduation. Four-year college aspirations, enrollment, and graduation increase along with earnings in adulthood. Students whose parents did not attend college and boys experience the largest effects. The evidence points to several mechanisms, including access to higher value-added schools, higher-achieving peers, and schools with stronger college-going norms. Participants are more likely to be tracked into lower-performing classes, implying that effects could be larger with access to more advanced coursework. District value-added estimates suggest that students’ educational trajectories shift at least as much as they would from growing up in the suburban districts.

abstract_cn: 学校分配政策是扩大优质学校入学机会、促进种族和社会经济融合的关键杠杆。五十多年来，大都会教育机会委员会（METCO）一直用校车将马萨诸塞州波士顿的有色人种学生送往相对更富裕且以白人为主的郊区。我通过比较收到入学录取通知的申请者与未收到录取通知的申请者，估计就读高绩效郊区学校的影响。两阶段最小二乘法利用了候补名单分配优先级，并控制了出生记录和申请数据中丰富的一组特征。就读郊区学校提高了数学和英语考试成绩，降低了辍学率，并提高了按时高中毕业率。四年制大学志向、入学率和毕业率上升，成年后的收入也随之增加。父母未上过大学的学生和男孩受到的影响最大。证据指向若干机制，包括获得更高增值学校的机会、更高成就的同龄人以及具有更强大学升学规范的学校。参与者更有可能被分轨到表现较低的班级，这意味着如果能够获得更高级的课程，影响可能会更大。学区增值估计表明，学生的教育轨迹至少会像在郊区学区成长那样发生同等程度的变化。

title: How Does Wage Inequality Affect the Labor Movement?
abstract: This paper provides evidence on how wage inequality among workers affects the labor movement using three complementary research designs: a vignette experiment with union organizers, a natural policy experiment that increased wage inequality among Wisconsin school teachers, and an information intervention during the 2023 Writers Guild of America strike. Across all studies, we find that inequality undermines union strength through multiple channels. First, workers with high individual bargaining power are more likely to withdraw support in unequal environments, preferring individual over collective bargaining. Second, union organizers facing hypothetical choices strategically respond to inequality in ways that may preserve membership but limit redistribution, such as shifting their campaign away from wages and choosing smaller, more homogeneous bargaining units.
title_cn: 工资不平等如何影响劳工运动？
abstract_cn: 本文利用三种互补的研究设计，为劳动者之间的工资不平等如何影响劳工运动提供了证据：一项针对工会组织者的情景实验、一项提高威斯康星州教师之间工资不平等的自然政策实验，以及2023年美国编剧协会罢工期间的一项信息干预。在所有研究中，我们发现不平等通过多种渠道削弱工会力量。第一，在 unequal 环境中，拥有较高个人议价能力的劳动者更可能撤回支持，偏好个体谈判而非集体谈判。第二，面对假设性选择的工会组织者会以可能保住会员但限制再分配的方式策略性地回应不平等，例如将竞选重点从工资转移开，并选择规模更小、同质性更高的谈判单位。

title: Markup Estimation Using Production and Demand Data: An Application to the U.S. Brewing Industry
abstract: We compare and combine two distinct approaches to estimating market power in the U.S. brewing industry—one based on production data, the other on demand. Both methods produce similar estimates of average markups and reveal a recent upward trend. We then combine the two approaches in two ways. First, we replace conventional instruments in demand estimation with a moment involving a production-based markup estimate, yielding similar results. We then evaluate the common (but controversial) assumption that retail markets operate competitively, finding that demand-based markups recovered with the assumption of competitive retail markets align with production-based estimates, as long as downstream costs are accounted for.
title_cn: 利用生产与需求数据估计加成率：以美国酿造业为例
abstract_cn: 我们比较并结合了两种估计美国酿酒业市场势力的不同方法——一种基于生产数据，另一种基于需求。两种方法给出的平均加成率估计相近，并都显示近期呈上升趋势。随后我们以两种方式结合这两种方法。首先，我们在需求估计中用涉及基于生产的加成率估计的矩条件替代传统工具变量，得到了相似的结果。接着，我们评估了零售市场以竞争性方式运行这一常见（但有争议的）假设，发现只要将下游成本纳入考虑，在竞争性零售市场假设下得到的需求侧加成率估计与基于生产的估计相一致。

title: Firm Balance Sheet Liquidity, Monetary Policy Shocks, and Investment Dynamics
abstract: I study the role of firms' balance sheet liquidity in the transmission of monetary policy to investment. I develop a heterogeneous firm macroeconomic model with financial constraints, debt issuance costs, and differential returns on firms' cash and borrowing. The model matches key novel moments from U.S. firm-level data on liquid asset holdings, debt issuance activity, and investment responses to identified monetary shocks. Counterfactual analysis shows that the rise in U.S. firms' liquid asset holdings over recent decades has significantly increased the relevance of balance sheet liquidity and the behavior of liquid asset returns in monetary transmission.
title_cn: 企业资产负债表流动性、货币政策冲击与投资动态
abstract_cn: 我研究企业资产负债表流动性在货币政策向投资传导中的作用。我构建了一个异质性企业宏观经济模型，其中包含金融约束、债务发行成本，以及企业现金与借款之间的收益率差异。该模型匹配了美国企业层面数据中关于流动资产持有、债务发行活动以及对已识别货币冲击的投资反应的关键新矩。反事实分析表明，近几十年来美国企业流动资产持有的上升显著提高了资产负债表流动性以及流动资产收益率行为在货币政策传导中的相关性。

title: Revisiting Retirement and Social Security Claiming Decisions
abstract: The structure of the Social Security program presents a trade-off between benefit duration and size; individuals who claim early receive lower monthly payments. Surprisingly, even wealthy Americans with high life expectancies frequently claim benefits at the earliest eligibility age, a behavior inconsistent with conventional life-cycle theory predictions. In fact, there is a striking similarity in claiming ages across groups with vastly different life expectancies, wealth levels, and incentives to delay. This paper resolves this puzzle by introducing policy details and subjective beliefs about longevity and program rules into a rich, forward-looking life-cycle model. When included in the model, subjective beliefs substantially narrow the claiming-age gaps across education (college vs. non-college) and marital-status (married vs. single) groups. Specifically, differences in program beliefs alone account for 48.6% of the education claiming age gap and 75.1% of the marital status gap. Counterfactual policy simulations demonstrate that failing to account for these claiming mechanisms dramatically overstates individual responses to an increase in the normal retirement age and understates the resulting fiscal savings.
title_cn: 重新审视退休与社会保障申领决策
abstract_cn: 社会保障项目的结构呈现出待遇持续时间与待遇规模之间的权衡；提前申领者每月领取的金额更低。令人意外的是，即便是预期寿命较长的富裕美国人，也常常在最早具备资格的年龄申领待遇，这一行为与传统生命周期理论的预测不一致。事实上，在预期寿命、财富水平和延迟申领激励差异巨大的各群体之间，申领年龄却呈现出惊人的相似性。本文通过将政策细节以及对寿命和项目规则的主观信念引入一个丰富的、前瞻性的生命周期模型，解开了这一谜题。将这些主观信念纳入模型后，不同教育群体（大学与非大学）以及不同婚姻状况群体（已婚与单身）之间的申领年龄差距大幅收窄。具体而言，仅项目信念差异一项就解释了教育群体申领年龄差距的 48.6% 和婚姻状况差距的 75.1%。反事实政策模拟表明，若不考虑这些申领机制，会大幅高估个人对正常退休年龄提高的反应，并低估由此带来的财政节省。

title: Bringing Work Home: Flexible Work Arrangements as Gateway Jobs for Women in West Bengal
abstract: There is a large latent workforce in developing countries that consists of hundreds of millions of women who prefer to have paid work and yet are out of the labor force. Often, available job opportunities are incompatible with traditional gender roles that encourage women to stay at home. In a randomized experiment with 1,670 households, we partner with a jobs platform to offer short-term data work to women who are out of the labor force. We find three main results. First, flexible work-from-home jobs are highly effective at bringing women into paid work. Job flexibility more than triples take-up from 15% for an office job to 48% for a job that women can do from home while multitasking with childcare. Second, these jobs can act as a stepping stone to less flexible work. Trying paid work from home increases take-up of less flexible jobs two to three months later among women without previous work experience. “Gateway jobs” are especially important for women from more traditional households: their labor supply is more likely to be marginal to flexibility, and in turn, work experience shifts their attitudes to become less traditional. Third, from the labor demand side, remote work comes with trade-offs in worker performance. Working from the office increases accuracy by 3% and speed by 18%. However, these performance drawbacks of work-from-home arrangements may be outweighed by the increase in available workers.
title_cn: 把工作带回家：灵活工作安排作为西孟加拉邦女性进入职场的门户岗位
abstract_cn: 发展中国家存在一支庞大的潜在劳动力队伍，由数亿名希望从事有酬工作却处于劳动力队伍之外的女性构成。现有工作机会往往与鼓励女性留在家中的传统性别角色不相容。在一项涉及 1,670 户家庭的随机实验中，我们与一个就业平台合作，向处于劳动力队伍之外的女性提供短期数据工作。我们得到三个主要结果。第一，灵活的家办公工作对于将女性带入有酬工作极为有效。工作灵活性使申领率提高两倍以上，从办公室工作的 15% 提高到女性可以在家一边照看孩子一边多任务处理的工作的 48%。第二，这些工作可以作为通向灵活性较低工作的踏脚石。尝试在家从事有酬工作，会使此前没有工作经验的女性在两到三个月后对灵活性较低工作的申领率上升。“门户工作”对来自更传统家庭的女性尤为重要：她们的劳动力供给更可能处于灵活性的边际上，进而，工作经验会改变她们的态度，使其变得不那么传统。第三，从劳动力需求侧看，远程工作伴随着劳动者绩效方面的权衡。在办公室工作使准确率提高 3%、速度提高 18%。然而，在家办公安排在绩效上的这些劣势，可能被可获得劳动者数量的增加所抵消。

title: Data, Privacy Laws and Firm Production: Evidence from the GDPR
abstract: By regulating how firms collect, store, and use data, privacy laws may change the role of data in production and alter firm demand for information technology inputs. We study how firms respond to privacy laws in the context of the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) by using seven years of data from a large global cloudcomputing provider. Our difference-in-difference estimates indicate that, in response to the GDPR, EU firms decreased data storage by 26% and data processing by 15% relative to comparable US firms, becoming less "data-intensive."To estimate the costs of the GDPR for firms, we propose and estimate a production function where data and computation serve as inputs to the production of "information."We find that data and computation are strong complements in production and that firm responses are consistent with the GDPR representing a 20% increase in the cost of data on average. Variation in the firm-level effects of the GDPR and industry-level exposure to data, however, drives significant heterogeneity in our estimates of the impact of the GDPR on production costs.
title_cn: 数据、隐私法与厂商生产：来自GDPR的证据
abstract_cn: 通过规范企业如何收集、存储和使用数据，隐私法可能改变数据在生产中的作用，并改变企业对信息技术投入品的需求。我们利用一家大型全球云计算提供商七年的数据，在欧盟《通用数据保护条例》（GDPR）的背景下研究企业如何回应隐私法。我们的双重差分估计表明，相对于可比美国企业，欧盟企业在回应 GDPR 时数据存储减少 26%、数据处理减少 15%，从而变得“数据密集度”更低。为估计 GDPR 给企业带来的成本，我们提出并估计了一个生产函数，其中数据和计算作为“信息”生产的投入品。我们发现，数据与计算在生产中是强互补品，且企业反应与 GDPR 平均使数据成本上升 20% 相一致。然而，GDPR 在企业层面效应的差异以及行业层面对数据暴露程度的差异，导致我们对 GDPR 影响生产成本估计存在显著异质性。

title: Carbon Prices, Forest Conservation and Reforestation in the Brazilian Amazon
abstract: Deforestation for cattle ranching in the Brazilian Amazon emits carbon, and reforestation absorbs carbon. The social productivities for these alternative activities vary across locations. We analyze a spatial/dynamic model of efficient land allocation to establish a benchmark for policies. We treat cattle prices as stochastic and location-specific productivities as uncertain when assessing the consequences of imposing alternative prices of carbon emissions. Modest carbon price increases would incentivize Brazil to choose policies that capture a significant amount of greenhouse gases in the next 30 years. Our analysis pinpoints tropical forest management as an important contributor to climate change mitigation.

abstract_cn: 巴西亚马逊地区为养牛而进行的森林砍伐会排放碳，而重新造林则会吸收碳。这些替代性活动的社会生产率因地点而异。我们分析一个空间/动态的有效土地配置模型，以建立政策基准。在评估施加替代性碳排放价格的后果时，我们将牛价视为随机，将地点特定生产率视为不确定。适度的碳价上升将激励巴西选择能在未来30年捕获大量温室气体的政策。我们的分析指出，热带森林管理是减缓气候变化的重要贡献因素。

title: Entry and Profits in an Aging Economy: The Role of Consumer Inertia
abstract: Over the past four decades, the U.S. economy has seen a decline in the share of young firms alongside a rise in the profit share of GDP. This paper explores how population aging contributes to these twin trends through a demand-side channel. The core hypothesis is that younger households exhibit lower consumer inertia—a tendency to stick with previously chosen products—than older households. As demand shifts toward more inertial consumers, entry becomes harder, incumbents raise markups, and market share tilts toward larger firms. To quantify this mechanism, I develop and calibrate a firm dynamics model with overlapping generations of consumers who differ in their degree of inertia. Using detailed micro data, I show that younger households are significantly less inertial. The model implies that population aging accounts for 20%–30% of the observed decline in young firms and rise in profits. Reduced-form evidence across U.S. states and product categories supports the model’s predictions.
title_cn: 老龄化经济中的进入与利润：消费者惯性的作用
abstract_cn: 过去四十年间，美国经济中年轻企业所占份额下降，同时利润占GDP的比重上升。本文探讨人口老龄化如何通过需求侧渠道促成这两大趋势。核心假设是，年轻家庭比年长家庭表现出更低的消费者惯性——即坚持此前所选产品的倾向。随着需求转向惯性更强的消费者，进入变得更加困难，现有企业提高加成，市场份额向更大企业倾斜。为量化这一机制，我构建并校准了一个企业动态模型，其中包含惯性程度不同的消费者世代交叠结构。利用详细的微观数据，我表明年轻家庭的惯性显著更低。模型意味着，人口老龄化可解释所观察到的年轻企业份额下降和利润上升的20%–30%。来自美国各州和产品类别的简约式证据支持模型的预测。

title: The End of Oil
abstract: Even as global oil demand has increased in recent years, it is plausible to envision scenarios in which clean energy technologies or climate policies drive demand to essentially zero by the century’s end. This article asks what such a demand decline, when anticipated, might mean for global oil supply. One possibility is a “green paradox”: producers accelerate extraction. However, because extraction requires durable capital investments, the opposite may occur: producers reduce their investment rate, decreasing extraction. To evaluate the relative strengths of these opposing mechanisms, I develop a model of global oil supply that incorporates both, among other industry features. For model inputs with the strongest empirical support, both effects are modest, with disinvestment typically outweighing the green paradox. In order for the green paradox to substantially increase cumulative global oil extraction, investments must have short time horizons, and producers’ discount rates must be less than 4% real.
title_cn: 石油时代的终结
abstract_cn: 尽管近年来全球石油需求有所上升，但可以设想这样的情景：到本世纪末，清洁能源技术或气候政策将使需求基本降至零。本文探讨这种可被预期的需求下降对全球石油供给可能意味着什么。一种可能是“绿色悖论”：生产商加速开采。然而，由于开采需要耐久的资本投资，也可能出现相反情形：生产商降低投资率，从而减少开采。为评估这两种相反机制的相对强度，我构建了一个纳入二者及其他行业特征的全球石油供给模型。对于实证支持最强的模型输入，两种效应均较为温和，撤资通常超过绿色悖论。要使绿色悖论显著提高全球石油累计开采量，投资期限必须较短，且生产商的实际贴现率必须低于4%。

title: Demographics, Wealth, and Global Imbalances in the Twenty-First Century
abstract: We use a sufficient statistic approach to quantify the general equilibrium effects of population ageing on the returns to wealth, wealth accumulation, and global imbalances. Combining population forecasts with household survey data from twenty-five countries, we measure the compositional effect of ageing: how a changing age distribution affects wealth-to-GDP, holding the age profiles of wealth and labour income fixed. In a baseline overlapping generations model this statistic, in conjunction with cross-sectional information and two standard macro parameters, pins down general equilibrium outcomes. Since the compositional effect is positive, large, and heterogeneous across countries, our model predicts that population ageing will lower returns to wealth, increase wealth-to-GDP ratios, and widen global imbalances through the twenty-first century. These conclusions extend to a richer model in which bequests, individual savings, and the tax-and-transfer system all respond to demographic change.
title_cn: 人口结构、财富与21世纪的全球失衡
abstract_cn: 我们使用充分统计量方法量化人口老龄化对财富收益率、财富积累和全球失衡的一般均衡效应。我们将人口预测与来自25个国家的家庭调查数据相结合，测度老龄化的构成效应：在财富和劳动收入的年龄剖面保持固定的情况下，年龄分布的变化如何影响财富与GDP之比。在基准世代交叠模型中，该统计量结合横截面信息和两个标准宏观参数，即可确定一般均衡结果。由于构成效应为正、规模较大且在不同国家之间存在异质性，我们的模型预测，在整个21世纪，人口老龄化将降低财富收益率、提高财富与GDP之比，并扩大全球失衡。这些结论可扩展至一个更丰富的模型，其中遗产、个人储蓄以及税收和转移支付体系均对人口结构变化作出反应。

title: Attention to the Macroeconomy
abstract: We measure which economic topics are top of mind using quarterly German household and firm panels from 2020 to 2024, a period that spans the post-pandemic inflation surge and the subsequent disinflation. With these data, we study potential determinants and consequences of having inflation top of mind. In line with goal-directed attention, the likelihood that inflation is top of mind rises with proxies for its true payoff relevance. At the same time, prior experiences predict whether respondents have inflation and energy prices top of mind conditional on a large set of controls for payoff relevance, and this relationship strengthens when the environment becomes more inflationary. Having inflation top of mind predicts stronger increases in information acquisition and inflation expectations over the shock period. At odds with goal-optimality, having inflation top of mind is associated with expectations further away from multiple ex-ante benchmarks. Finally, both key determinants of having inflation top of mind—payoff relevance and prior experiences—are associated with stronger shifts of expectations away from these benchmarks over the shock period.
title_cn: 对宏观经济的关注
abstract_cn: 我们使用2020年至2024年的季度德国家庭和企业面板数据，衡量哪些经济话题最受关注，这一时期跨越了疫情后的通胀飙升及随后的去通胀过程。基于这些数据，我们研究通胀成为最受关注话题的潜在决定因素与后果。与目标导向型注意力一致，通胀成为最受关注话题的可能性随其真实收益相关性的代理变量上升而上升。与此同时，在大量控制收益相关性的条件下，先前经历能够预测受访者是否将通胀和能源价格视为最受关注的话题，且当环境变得更具通胀性时，这一关系增强。通胀成为最受关注话题预示着在冲击期间信息获取和通胀预期的更大幅度上升。与目标最优性相悖的是，通胀成为最受关注话题与预期偏离多个事前基准更远相关联。最后，通胀成为最受关注话题的两个关键决定因素——收益相关性和先前经历——都与冲击期间预期更大幅度地偏离这些基准相关联。

title: Machine Learning for Dynamic Incentive Problems
abstract: We present a flexible and scalable computational framework integrating machine learning and optimization theory to solve dynamic adverse selection models with persistent private information and many types. Our approach reformulates the model into a numerically tractable structure that bypasses set-valued dynamic programming; we formally prove that, under verifiable conditions, this relaxation yields the solution to the original problem. The recast problem is solved via a parallelized value function iteration algorithm, where high-dimensional, nonlinear functions are approximated using Gaussian process regression combined with Bayesian active learning. We apply our framework to two previously intractable models: one with persistent hidden information involving up to ten types and another incorporating multiple persistent types and overreporting. Validation against known solutions and rigorous credibility measures confirms accuracy. Allowing overreporting significantly alters long-run contract outcomes, concentrating consumption away from extremes and smoothing utility promises over time.
title_cn: 机器学习用于动态激励问题
abstract_cn: 我们提出一个灵活且可扩展的计算框架，将机器学习与优化理论相结合，用于求解具有持续性私人信息和多种类型的动态逆向选择模型。我们的方法将模型重新表述为一个数值上易处理的结构，从而绕开集值动态规划；我们正式证明，在可验证的条件下，这一松弛可得到原问题的解。重新表述后的问题通过并行化值函数迭代算法求解，其中高维非线性函数采用高斯过程回归结合贝叶斯主动学习进行近似。我们将该框架应用于两个此前难以处理的模型：一个涉及最多十种类型的持续性隐藏信息模型，另一个则包含多种持续性类型和过度报告。与已知解的对比验证以及严格的可信度度量均确认了准确性。允许过度报告会显著改变长期合同结果，使消费从极端值向中间集中，并在时间上平滑效用承诺。

title: Measuring Markets for Network Goods
abstract: Market definition is challenging in settings with network effects, where substitution patterns depend on changes in network size. We study these effects in the context of social media. We conduct an incentivized experiment comparing substitution in response to a proposed U.S. TikTok ban, in which all users simultaneously leave the app, with substitution when only a single user deactivates. We find substantially higher valuations of alternative social apps under a collective TikTok ban than under an individual TikTok deactivation. Mechanism evidence shows that both anticipated content-supply shifts and social coordination partly explain the wedge, with the relative importance of each channel varying across platforms. We then show that a collective time limit challenge, where peers jointly reduce TikTok and Instagram use, leads to more time spent on alternative social apps than has been observed in prior individual deactivation experiments. Together, our results suggest that individual-level substitution estimates can be an unreliable guide to market definition for network goods.
title_cn: 衡量网络产品市场
abstract_cn: 在网络效应存在的环境中，市场界定颇具挑战性，因为替代模式取决于网络规模的变化。我们在社交媒体情境下研究这些效应。我们开展了一项激励实验，比较在拟议的美国 TikTok 禁令下所有用户同时退出该应用时的替代行为，与仅有单个用户停用时的替代行为。我们发现，在集体 TikTok 禁令下，用户对替代社交应用的估值显著高于单个用户停用 TikTok 时的估值。机制证据表明，预期内容供给变化与社会协调部分解释了这一差异，且各渠道的相对重要性因平台而异。随后我们表明，在同伴共同减少 TikTok 和 Instagram 使用的集体时间限制挑战下，用户在替代社交应用上花费的时间多于此前单个停用实验中所观察到的情况。综合来看，我们的结果表明，个体层面的替代估计可能无法可靠地指导网络产品的市场界定。

title: Company Wage Policy in a Low-Wage Labour Market
abstract: We study how firms set wages for their employees when they can legally age-discriminate across workers. We exploit an age-specific minimum wage change in the UK, which raised the minimum applying to workers aged 25 and over, leaving unchanged the minima for younger workers. Using matched employer-employee data on a low-paying sector, we show large, positive wage spillovers on workers aged under 25, which arise within firms from company wage policy. Pay equity norms offer the most parsimonious explanation for the emergence of spillovers. The effects that we document also operate in other low-paying sectors of the UK labour market.
title_cn: 低工资劳动力市场中的企业工资政策
abstract_cn: 我们研究在企业可以合法地对不同年龄劳动者实施年龄歧视的情况下，企业如何为其员工设定工资。我们利用英国一项针对特定年龄的最低工资变动：该变动提高了适用于25岁及以上劳动者的最低工资，而未改变较年轻劳动者的最低工资。使用一个低工资部门的雇主—雇员匹配数据，我们表明，25岁以下劳动者获得了大幅且正向的工资溢出，这些溢出在企业内部源于公司工资政策。薪酬公平规范为溢出的出现提供了最简约的解释。我们所记录的效果同样存在于英国劳动力市场的其他低工资部门。

title: Stockups, Stockouts, and the Role for Strategic Reserves
abstract: We study how supply disruptions interact with monopoly pricing, inventory management, and consumer stockpiling in a continuous-time model. Pre-emption incentives—consumers prefer to stock up before a price hike while the firm prefers to hike before consumers stock up—lead to an equilibrium with gradual stockpiling and endogenous uncertainty over the timing of a price hike, which can trigger a run at the disruption onset. Consumer storage introduces welfare losses from randomized pricing, but can also strengthen the firm’s incentive to hold buffer stock. Rationing, price controls, and reserve mandates can each improve welfare, but only strategic government reserves can implement the social optimum.
title_cn: 囤积、缺货与战略储备的作用
abstract_cn: 我们研究在连续时间模型中，供给中断如何与垄断定价、库存管理和消费者囤积相互作用。先占激励——消费者倾向于在涨价前囤货，而企业倾向于在消费者囤货前涨价——导致均衡中出现逐步囤积以及对涨价时点的内生不确定性，这种不确定性可能在供给中断开始时引发抢购。消费者储存会因随机定价带来福利损失，但也能增强企业持有缓冲库存的激励。配给、价格管制和储备要求各自都能改善福利，但只有战略性政府储备才能实现社会最优。

title: Equilibrium in the Market for Public School Teachers: District Wage Strategies and Teacher Comparative Advantage
abstract: We study the equity-efficiency implication of giving school districts control over teacher pay using an equilibrium model of the market for public-school teachers. Teachers differ in their comparative advantages in teaching low-or high-achieving students. School districts, which serve different student bodies, use both wage and hiring strategies to compete for their preferred teachers. We estimate the model using data from Wisconsin, where districts gained control over teacher pay in 2011. We find that, all else equal, giving districts control over teacher pay would lead to more efficient teacher-district sorting but larger educational inequality. Teacher bonus programs that incentivize comparative advantage-based sorting, combined with bonus rates favoring districts with more low-achieving students, could improve both efficiency and equity.
title_cn: 公立学校教师市场的均衡：学区工资策略与教师比较优势
abstract_cn: 我们利用一个公立学校教师市场均衡模型，研究赋予学区教师薪酬控制权所带来的公平与效率含义。教师在教学低成就学生或高成就学生上具有不同的比较优势。服务于不同学生群体的学区同时运用工资策略和招聘策略来竞争其偏好的教师。我们使用威斯康星州的数据估计该模型，该州学区在2011年获得了教师薪酬控制权。我们发现，在其他条件相同的情况下，赋予学区教师薪酬控制权会带来更有效的教师—学区匹配，但也会扩大教育不平等。激励基于比较优势进行匹配的教师奖金计划，若结合向低成就学生较多的学区倾斜的奖金比例，则可能同时改善效率与公平。

title: Behavioral Attenuation
abstract: We report a large-scale examination of behavioral attenuation: due to information-processing constraints, the elasticity of people’s decisions to fundamentals is generally too small. We implement 30 experiments on a broad range of economic decisions, including choice, valuation, belief formation, strategic games and generic optimization. In 93% of our experiments, the elasticity of decisions to fundamentals decreases in participants’ cognitive uncertainty. Moreover, in decision problems with objective solutions, elasticities are universally smaller than is optimal. We show that the magnitude of attenuation is partly driven by the complexity of the decision problem. Many widely-studied anomalies represent special cases of behavioral attenuation.
title_cn: 行为衰减
abstract_cn: 我们报告了一项关于行为衰减的大规模检验：由于信息处理约束，人们对基本面的决策弹性通常过小。我们针对广泛的经济决策实施了30项实验，包括选择、估值、信念形成、策略博弈和一般性优化。在我们的实验中，93%的实验显示，决策对基本面的弹性随参与者认知不确定性的上升而下降。此外，在具有客观解的决策问题中，弹性普遍小于最优水平。我们表明，衰减的幅度部分由决策问题的复杂性驱动。许多被广泛研究的异象是行为衰减的特例。

title: Fairness Across the World
abstract: This article provides the first comprehensive global evidence on people’s fairness and efficiency preferences, beliefs about the sources of inequality and the efficiency cost of redistribution, and policy attitudes toward redistribution. Using a globally harmonized consequential experiment with more than 65,000 individuals across 60 countries, we show that the source of inequality plays a substantially larger role for inequality acceptance than the efficiency cost of redistribution. At the global level, implemented inequality increases by 85% when inequality is caused by merit rather than luck, compared with a 14% increase when redistribution entails a 50% efficiency cost. We document substantial heterogeneity in fairness views and beliefs within and across societies. The meritocratic fairness view is most prominent in many richer Western societies, while libertarian and egalitarian fairness views are widespread in many other parts of the world. Globally, people are more likely to believe that inequality reflects luck rather than merit, while beliefs in large efficiency costs of redistribution are relatively weak. Fairness preferences and beliefs are strongly associated with redistribution attitudes and actual redistribution through taxes and transfers across countries. Our findings illustrate how the interaction between fairness views and beliefs may shape redistribution across societies, highlighting the importance of jointly understanding preferences and beliefs in the political economy of redistribution.
title_cn: 世界范围内的公平
abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于人们的公平与效率偏好、对不平等来源及再分配效率成本的信念，以及对再分配的政策态度的首个全球性系统证据。基于一项在60个国家、超过65000名个体中开展的全球统一化有后果实验，我们表明，不平等来源对不平等接受度的影响远大于再分配的效率成本。在全球层面，当不平等由功绩而非运气造成时，实际实施的不平等程度上升85%；相比之下，当再分配带来50%的效率成本时，不平等程度仅上升14%。我们记录了各社会内部及社会之间在公平观和信念上的显著异质性。精英 meritocratic 公平观在许多较富裕的西方社会最为突出，而自由至上主义和平均主义公平观在世界许多其他地区广泛存在。在全球范围内，人们更倾向于认为不平等反映的是运气而非功绩，而认为再分配具有较大效率成本的信念相对较弱。公平偏好与信念同再分配态度以及各国通过税收和转移支付实现的实际再分配密切相关。我们的发现表明，公平观与信念之间的相互作用如何塑造各社会的再分配，凸显了在再分配的政治经济学中联合理解偏好与信念的重要性。

title: Wealth and Property Taxation in the United States
abstract: We study the history and geography of wealth accumulation in the United States using newly collected historical property tax records from the early 1800s onward. These records come from the administration of the General Property Tax—a tax that aspired to cover all types of property. We construct wealth series at the state, county, and national levels. At the state level, we use annual assessed values of wealth from state-level reports drawn from multiple sources. Because assessed values may differ from market values, we also require assessment ratios, defined as the ratio of assessed to market wealth. We obtain state-level assessment ratios from decadal U.S. Census wealth data (drawn from various census reports, including those on “Wealth, Debt, and Taxation”), in which the census carried out detailed valuation work, complemented with information on changes in assessment practices from the state reports, to build higher-frequency series of assessment ratios. The result is long-run annual wealth series for states from 1850 (or earlier, depending on the state) to 1935. We obtain national wealth series by aggregating these state series. At the county level, we use assessed values (or market values where available) from the U.S. Census wealth data for each decade and apply either state-level or county-level assessment ratios, where available, to obtain market values of wealth for each decade from 1850 to 1930. We use these data to show, first, that the United States experienced extraordinary wealth accumulation after the Civil War and until the Great Depression. Second, spatial inequality in the United States has been large and highly persistent since the mid-1800s. We also examine the determinants of long-term wealth growth and find, among other results, that counties with a higher share of enslaved property before the Civil War or with higher wealth inequality experienced lower subsequent long-run wealth growth.
title_cn: 美国的财富税与财产税
abstract_cn: 我们利用新收集的19世纪初以来历史财产税记录，研究美国财富积累的历史与地理分布。这些记录来自一般财产税的征管——该税种力图覆盖所有类型的财产。我们构建了州、县和国家层面的财富序列。在州层面，我们使用来自多类来源的州级报告中年度财富评估值。由于评估值可能不同于市场价值，我们还需要评估比率，即评估财富与市场财富之比。我们从十年一次的美国人口普查财富数据（取自包括“财富、债务与税收”在内的各类普查报告）中获得州级评估比率，普查在这些数据中开展了详细估值工作，并结合州报告中关于评估实践变化的信息，构建更高频率的评估比率序列。由此得到各州自1850年（或更早，视州而定）至1935年的长期年度财富序列。我们通过加总这些州序列得到国家财富序列。在县层面，我们使用美国人口普查财富数据中每个十年的评估值（或在可得时使用市场价值），并在可得时应用州级或县级评估比率，以获得1850年至1930年每个十年的市场财富价值。我们利用这些数据表明：第一，美国在南北战争后至大萧条期间经历了非凡的财富积累。第二，自19世纪中叶以来，美国空间不平等程度一直很高且高度持续。我们还考察了长期财富增长的决定因素，并发现，除其他结果外，南北战争前奴隶财产份额更高或财富不平等更高的县，其随后的长期财富增长更低。

title: Equity Frictions and Firm Ownership
abstract: In this paper, I document systematic heterogeneity in ownership and financing of firms across Eurozone countries. To rationalize these differences, I build a quantitative general equilibrium model of workers and entrepreneurs who choose debt and equity financing of their firms, subject to rich country-specific financial frictions. The novel data on firm ownership and financing, combined with the structure of the model, allows me to quantify the level of debt and equity frictions in each country. Quantitatively, I find much larger output effects from equity frictions: harmonizing them across countries would lead to nearly four times larger output effects compared to debt frictions, and removing them would increase aggregate output by 73% more. The larger impact on output is due not only to the estimated levels and dispersion of equity frictions but also to the greater risk sharing provided by equity, which further incentivizes entrepreneurs to expand their firms. Through their effect on risk sharing, equity frictions also rationalize the observed negative relationship between equity financing and wealth inequality. Quantitatively, they are responsible for over 70% of the explained variation in top wealth shares across countries.
title_cn: 股权摩擦与企业所有权
abstract_cn: 本文记录了欧元区各国在企业所有权和融资方面存在的系统性异质性。为解释这些差异，我构建了一个包含劳动者和企业家的量化一般均衡模型，经济主体在丰富的国别金融摩擦约束下为企业选择债务融资和股权融资。关于企业所有权和融资的新颖数据，结合模型结构，使我能够量化每个国家的债务摩擦和股权摩擦水平。在量化层面，我发现股权摩擦带来的产出效应要大得多：在各国之间统一股权摩擦所带来的产出效应，几乎是统一债务摩擦的近四倍；而消除股权摩擦使总产出增加的幅度，比消除债务摩擦高出 73%。股权摩擦对产出更大的影响，不仅源于估计出的股权摩擦水平和离散程度，还源于股权所提供的更大风险分担，这进一步激励企业家扩张企业。通过其对风险分担的影响，股权摩擦也解释了所观察到的股权融资与财富不平等之间的负向关系。在量化层面，在各国顶层财富份额的可解释变异中，股权摩擦贡献了超过 70%。

title: Not Learning from Others
abstract: We study social learning using experiments where two people independently learn relevant information and can share it to make accurate private decisions. Across three experiments, people are substantially less sensitive to information others discover than to equally-relevant information they discovered themselves. This holds when they must learn information from others through discussion; when the experimenter perfectly communicates the information; and even when participants observe others’ information with their own eyes. Our results therefore stem not from a failure to elicit information from others but a systematic tendency to underweight it relative to one’s own information. Our findings illustrate a powerful barrier to social learning that might underlie many documented cases of failure to learn from others.
title_cn: 不从他人处学习
abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究社会学习：在实验中，两个人各自独立地获取相关信息，并且可以共享这些信息以做出准确的私人决策。在三项实验中，人们对于他人发现的信息的敏感程度，显著低于对自身发现的同等相关信息。这一结果在以下情形下均成立：他们必须通过讨论从他人那里获取信息时；实验者完美地传达信息时；甚至当参与者亲眼观察他人的信息时。因此，我们的结果并非源于未能从他人那里获取信息，而是源于一种系统性的倾向，即相对于自身信息而言低估他人信息。我们的发现揭示了一种社会学习的强大障碍，它可能解释了许多已记录的未能从他人处学习的案例。

title: Collusion through Common Leadership
abstract: This paper studies whether common leadership, defined as two firms sharing executives or board directors, contributes to collusion. Using an explicit measure of labor market collusion from unsealed court evidence, we find that the probability of collusion between two firms increases by 11 percentage points after the onset of common leadership, a ninefold increase over the baseline rate. These results are not driven by closeness of product or labor market competition. Our findings are consistent with the increasing attention toward common leadership under Clayton Act Section 8. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

title: The Long Run Economic Effects of Medical Innovation and the Role of Opportunities
abstract: We leverage the introduction of the first antibiotic therapies in 1937 to examine the long-run effects of early childhood pneumonia on adult educational attainment, employment, income, and work-related disability. Using census data, we document large average gains on all outcomes, alongside substantial heterogeneity by race and gender. On average, Black men exhibit smaller schooling gains than white men but larger employment and earnings gains. Among Black men (and women), we identify a pronounced gradient in gains linked to systemic racial discrimination in the pre–Civil Rights era: individuals born in more discriminatory Jim Crow states realized much smaller gains than those born in less discriminatory states. There is no similar gradient among white Americans. Women of both races exhibit smaller education and earnings gains than men on average, consistent with cultural and institutional barriers to women's work. Our findings highlight the role of opportunities in shaping the extent to which investments in early-life health translate into longer run economic gains.

title: The Environmental Bias of Corporate Income Taxation
abstract: We study the relationship between corporate income taxation and carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) emissions in the United States. We show CO 2 -intensive firms benefit more from the tax advantage of debt and pay lower income taxes on their capital income. Building on these new facts, we provide evidence that a cut in the corporate income tax rate leads to a larger expansion of clean firms. We develop a multisector general equilibrium model that accounts for our evidence and quantify the impact of corporate tax reforms on aggregate emissions. A policy that eliminates the tax advantage of debt could reduce aggregate emissions without affecting GDP. (JEL D22, G32, H25, H32, Q52, Q54, Q58)

title: Marriage, Fertility, and Cultural Integration in Italy
abstract: We study cultural integration as an equilibrium outcome of marital matching along cultural and education lines and intrahousehold investment decisions regarding fertility and cultural socialization. Our model allows us to identify cultural-ethnic-group-specific investment parameters and spousal preferences for marital matching. Structural estimates reveal a strong demand to preserve cultural identity on the part of immigrants and limited acceptance of the immigrants' cultural diversity on the part of natives. Furthermore, these estimates reveal a substantial heterogeneity of the parental value of children's education across cultures. Nonetheless, our estimates simulate substantial—though heterogeneous—cultural integration rates across immigrant groups. (JEL D13, J12, J13, J15, Z13)

title: Manipulation-Robust Prediction
abstract: An increasing number of decisions are guided by machine learning algorithms. But when consequential decisions are encoded in algorithms, individuals may strategically alter their behavior to achieve desired outcomes. This paper develops an empirical approach that adjusts decision algorithms to anticipate manipulation. By explicitly modeling incentives to manipulate, our approach produces decision rules that are stable under manipulation, even when the rules are fully transparent. We stress-test this approach through a large field experiment in Kenya. When implemented, linear strategy-robust decision rules outperform standard linear models such as LASSO. (JEL C45, C93, D12, D91, G51, O12, O16)

title: Intergenerational Impacts of Secondary Education: Experimental Evidence from Ghana
abstract: We provide experimental evidence on the intergenerational impacts of secondary education subsidies in a low-income context, leveraging a randomized controlled trial and 15-year longitudinal follow-up. Secondary school scholarships delay fertility, reduce unwanted pregnancies, and change partner selection. Under-one mortality is reduced by half. We also document cognitive development gains of 0.24 standard deviations of test scores by age five among children of female scholarship recipients. Means-tested secondary school scholarships are a high-return investment, with a conservatively estimated US$4.1 in benefits for each US$1 the policy would cost the government in the long run. (JEL H52, I12, I21, I26, J13, J16, O15)

title: Defying Distance? The Provision of Medical Services in the Digital Age
abstract: Digital platforms reduce geographic frictions, enabling better matching between service providers and users. I quantify reallocation gains in Swedish online health care, using nationwide time-conditional random assignment between patients and physicians. Matching high-risk patients with doctors effective at reducing Emergency Room visits lowers such visits by 4.4 percent (SE 1.3); reallocations also reduce Counter-Guideline antibiotics by 3.1 percent (1.4). I find limited trade-offs in matching; horizontal differentiation among doctors and varied patient needs allow improvement in multiple outcomes simultaneously. Efficiency-enhancing reallocations also affect equity. The findings highlight the potential for care reorganization aligning provider heterogeneity with patient needs when geographic constraints are lifted. (JEL C78, H51, I11, I13, I14, I18)

title: Rationing by Race
abstract: We document how deepening resource scarcity results in rationing on the basis of race in a high-stakes setting: health care. Using detailed, time stamped data on 107,000 inpatient admissions to a large health system, we find that in-hospital mortality increases for Black but not White patients as hospitals reach capacity. These findings are not explained by differential patient selection. We identify rationing by wait times as a mechanism, documenting that sicker Black patients wait longer for care than healthier White patients at almost all capacity levels. Text analysis of unstructured clinical notes reveals rationing of provider effort as another mechanism. (JEL I11, I12, I14, J15)

abstract_cn: 我们记录了资源稀缺加剧如何在一种高风险情境——医疗保健——中导致基于种族的配给。利用某大型医疗系统107,000例住院入院的时间戳详细数据，我们发现，随着医院达到容量上限，黑人患者的院内死亡率上升，而白人患者则没有出现这一上升。这些发现无法由患者选择差异来解释。我们识别出等待时间配给作为一种机制，记录到在几乎所有容量水平下，病情更重的黑人患者比病情更轻的白人患者等待更长时间才能获得照护。对非结构化临床记录文本的分析揭示了医疗服务提供者努力程度的配给作为另一机制。(JEL I11, I12, I14, J15)

title: Risk-Sharing Tests and Covariate Shocks: Drought, Floods, and Pests in Uganda
abstract: Efficient risk sharing implies a simple factor structure for marginal utilities of expenditure (MUEs): Pareto weights divided by a common price. The standard approach infers MUEs from total expenditures, implicitly assuming homothetic preferences, unitary income elasticities, and identical price elasticities. Risk-sharing tests using total expenditures work for idiosyncratic shocks (budgets change, but not prices), but not “covariate” shocks (prices change). I describe all preferences that permit one to infer MUEs from expenditures and estimate nonhomothetic MUEs to test whether covariate shocks are shared efficiently in Uganda. This delivers sensible results; the standard approach suggests that droughts, floods, and pests are beneficial. (JEL D12, D81, O12, O13, Q12)
title_cn: 风险分担检验与协变量冲击：乌干达的干旱、洪水和病虫害
abstract_cn: 有效的风险分担意味着支出边际效用（MUEs）具有简单的因子结构：帕累托权重除以一个共同价格。标准方法从总支出推断支出边际效用，隐含地假设偏好同质、收入弹性为单位值以及价格弹性相同。使用总支出的风险分担检验适用于个体特异性冲击（预算变化，但价格不变），但不适用于“共同”冲击（价格变化）。我描述了所有允许从支出推断支出边际效用的偏好，并估计非同位相似的支出边际效用，以检验乌干达的共同冲击是否得到有效分担。这得出了合理的结果；而标准方法却表明干旱、洪水和病虫害是有益的。（JEL D12, D81, O12, O13, Q12）

title: Contextually Private Mechanisms
abstract: A designer employs a dynamic protocol to elicit private information. Protocols produce a set of contextual privacy violations—information learned that may be superfluous given the context. A protocol is maximally contextually private if there is no protocol that produces a proper subset of the violations it produces, while implementing the choice rule. Contextual privacy violations arise when a choice rule makes some agents collectively, but not individually, pivotal. In auctions, designing for contextual privacy requires choosing an initial question posed to each agent and the order for querying agents. Ascending-join protocols are maximally contextually private for k-item Vickrey auctions. (JEL D44, D82)
title_cn: 情境私密机制
abstract_cn: 设计者采用动态协议来揭示私人信息。协议会产生一组情境隐私侵犯——即所获知的、在给定情境下可能多余的信息。若不存在另一个协议，在实施该选择规则的同时所产生的隐私侵犯是其产生侵犯的真子集，则该协议是最大情境隐私的。当选择规则使某些经济主体集体而非个体成为关键者时，就会出现情境隐私侵犯。在拍卖中，为情境隐私而设计需要选择向每个经济主体提出的初始问题以及询问经济主体的顺序。升序加入协议对于 k 件物品的 Vickrey 拍卖是最大情境隐私的。（JEL D44, D82）

title: Corporate Tax Cuts, Firm Growth, and Workers' Earnings
abstract: We study the effects of the largest corporate income tax cut in US history on firms and workers. To identify causal effects, we use employer-employee matched tax records and event studies comparing similarly sized firms in the same industry that faced divergent tax changes due to their preexisting legal status. Tax cuts cause increases in firms' investment, sales, profits, employment, and payrolls, with earnings gains concentrated among highly paid workers. In the short run, 87 percent of private income gains flow to the top 10 percent of the income distribution. (JEL D22, D31, G31, H25, H32, J23, L25)
