title: Optimal Public Transportation Networks: Evidence from the World's Largest Bus Rapid Transit System in Jakarta
abstract: Designing public transport networks involves trade-offs between coverage, service frequency, and direct service. We use the expansion of the bus system in Jakarta, Indonesia, to study these trade-offs. We analyze how new direct connections, changes in bus travel time, and wait-time reductions affect bus ridership and aggregate flows and estimate a transit network demand model by matching the route launch events. Commuters in Jakarta are 2–3 times more sensitive to wait time than bus time and inattentive to long routes. We develop a flexible framework to characterize optimal networks. A less concentrated network would increase ridership and commuter welfare. (JEL L92, L98, O18, R41, R42, R48)
title_cn: 最优公共交通网络：来自雅加达全球最大快速公交系统的证据
abstract_cn: 设计公共交通网络需要在覆盖范围、服务频率和直达服务之间进行权衡。我们利用印度尼西亚雅加达公交系统的扩张来研究这些权衡。我们分析新的直达连接、公交出行时间变化以及等待时间缩短如何影响公交客流量和总量流动，并通过匹配线路开通事件来估计一个公交网络需求模型。雅加达的通勤者对等待时间的敏感程度是公交出行时间的2—3倍，并且对长线路不敏感。我们构建了一个灵活的框架来刻画最优网络。一个集中度更低的网络将提高客流量和通勤者福利。（JEL L92, L98, O18, R41, R42, R48）

title: Presidential Address: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children's adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an undersupply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children's future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children. (JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J15, R23, R38)

abstract_cn: 实验研究和准实验研究表明，童年居住的社区对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。若干市场失灵很可能导致按父母收入形成的过度居住隔离，以及混合收入社区供给不足。机会市场缺失源于以下方面：以子女未来收入为抵押进行借贷的资本市场不完全性、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可以帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的地区。旨在创建混合收入社区的基于地点的政策似乎能够改善弱势儿童的长期结果。（JEL I12, I32, I38, J13, J15, R23, R38）

title: Public Employee Pensions and Municipal Insolvency
abstract: This paper studies how municipal governments jointly manage spending, credit market borrowing, and a public employee pension system. I model governments as levered investors who must meet non-defaultable pension obligations and may value government spending more than citizens. I quantify the model using data on California cities, including a new record of fiscal emergencies, tax increases required to maintain essential city services. After the financial crisis depleted pension funds, cities engaged in excessive risk-taking: the fiscal emergency option encouraged gambling for resurrection that kept cities vulnerable to shocks well into the recovery. To correct this problem, a savings requirement works better than a restriction on risk-taking or a pension funding requirement. The policy experiments emphasize that effective policies need to target the combined pension and bond finances, as policies that only target one, such as a pension funding requirement, are undermined by endogenous changes to the other.
title_cn: 公共部门雇员养老金与市政破产
abstract_cn: 本文研究市政府如何统筹管理支出、信贷市场借款和公共雇员养老金体系。我将政府建模为杠杆投资者，其必须履行不可违约的养老金义务，并且可能比公民更看重政府支出。我利用加利福尼亚州城市的数据对模型进行量化，其中包括一份关于财政紧急状态的新记录，即为维持城市基本服务所需的增税。金融危机耗尽养老基金后，城市进行了过度风险承担：财政紧急状态选项鼓励了“赌一把以求翻身”的行为，使城市在复苏很久之后仍易受冲击。为纠正这一问题，储蓄要求比限制风险承担或养老金注资要求更有效。政策实验强调，有效的政策需要同时针对养老金和债券融资的组合，因为只针对其中一项的政策（如养老金注资要求）会被另一项的内生变化所削弱。

title: Paying to Match: Decentralized Markets with Information Frictions
abstract: We experimentally study decentralized one-to-one matching markets with transfers. We vary the information available to participants, complete or incomplete, and the surplus structure, supermodular or submodular. Several insights emerge. First, while markets often culminate in efficient matchings, stability is more elusive, reflecting the difficulty of arranging attendant transfers. Second, incomplete information and submodularity present hurdles to efficiency and especially stability; their combination drastically diminishes stability’s likelihood. Third, matchings form “from the top down” in complete-information supermodular markets, but exhibit many more and less-obviously ordered offers otherwise. Last, participants’ market positions matter far more than their dynamic bargaining styles for outcomes.
title_cn: 付费匹配：存在信息摩擦的分散化市场
abstract_cn: 我们通过实验研究带有转移支付的分散式一对一匹配市场。我们改变参与者可获得的信息（完全信息或不完全信息）以及剩余结构（超模或次模）。由此得到若干发现。第一，尽管市场往往最终实现有效匹配，但稳定性更难实现，这反映出安排相应转移支付的困难。第二，不完全信息和次模性对效率、尤其是稳定性构成障碍；二者结合会大幅降低稳定性出现的可能性。第三，在完全信息超模市场中，匹配“自上而下”形成；而在其他情形下，报价数量更多，且顺序不那么明显。最后，参与者的市场位置对结果的影响远大于其动态议价风格。

title: Why Veil? Religious Headscarves and the Economic Role of Women
abstract: We show that the emergence of new economic opportunities that draw women away from their traditional domestic roles has significantly influenced the adoption of religious veiling. We measure the prevalence of veiling among young women across Indonesia’s districts for more than two decades by hand-coding around a quarter million photographs attached to Indonesia’s public high school registers. To establish causality, we exploit exogenous variation generated by international demand for Indonesia’s products, interacted with the gender and sectoral composition of local industries. Districts exposed to stronger positive economic shocks—and thus greater economic opportunities for women—exhibit higher rates of veiling adoption. Our findings suggest that veiling facilitates young women’s participation in formal labour markets while safeguarding their personal and social image in society.
title_cn: 为何戴面纱？宗教头巾与女性的经济角色
abstract_cn: 我们表明，将女性从传统家庭角色中吸引出来的新经济机会的出现，显著影响了宗教面纱的采用。我们通过手工编码印度尼西亚公立高中登记册上附带的约25万张照片，衡量了印度尼西亚各地区年轻女性在二十多年间佩戴面纱的普遍程度。为确立因果关系，我们利用印度尼西亚产品国际需求所产生的外生变异，并将其与当地产业的性别和部门构成进行交互。受到更强正向经济冲击——因而女性拥有更大经济机会——的地区，面纱采用率更高。我们的发现表明，面纱有助于年轻女性参与正规劳动力市场，同时维护其在社会中的个人形象和社会形象。

title: Early-Career Discrimination: Spiralling or Self-Correcting?
abstract: Do workers from social groups with comparable productivity distributions obtain comparable lifetime earnings? We study how a small amount of early-career discrimination propagates over time when workers’ productivity is revealed through employment. In breakdown learning environments that primarily track on-the-job failures, such discrimination spirals into a substantial lifetime earnings gap for groups of comparable productivity, whereas in breakthrough learning environments that track successes, early-career discrimination can be self-corrected, so comparable groups obtain comparable lifetime earnings. This contrast persists in large labour markets and with flexible wages, inconclusive learning, and misspecified employer beliefs.
title_cn: 早期职业歧视：螺旋式恶化还是自我纠正？
abstract_cn: 来自生产率分布可比的社会群体的劳动者，是否能够获得可比的终身收入？我们研究了当劳动者的生产率通过就业经历逐步显现时，职业生涯早期少量的歧视如何随时间推移而扩散。在主要追踪在职失败经历的“中断式”学习环境中，这种歧视会不断放大，使生产率可比的群体之间形成显著的终身收入差距；而在追踪成功经历的“突破式”学习环境中，职业生涯早期的歧视能够自我纠正，因而可比的群体能够获得可比的终身收入。这一对比在大型劳动力市场中依然成立，并且在工资灵活、学习结果不确定以及雇主信念错误设定的情形下也持续存在。

title: Labour Supply and the Pension Contribution–Benefit Link
abstract: We estimate the impact of public pension incentives on labour supply far from the normal retirement age by exploiting Poland’s switch from a defined benefit to a notional defined contribution (NDC) scheme. This reform created a sharp cohort-based discontinuity in the link between current pension contributions and future benefits. Using this discontinuity and the universe of taxpayers, we estimate an employment elasticity with respect to the net return to work of 0.51 for men at ages 51–54. We estimate a lifecycle model to match these responses and discuss the broader implications of the reform. The shift to NDC reallocates work incentives over the lifecycle, strengthening incentives at younger ages, when labour supply is relatively inelastic, and weakening them at older ages, when labour supply is more elastic. This reallocation of work incentives tends to reduce aggregate lifecycle labour supply, which highlights the advantage of targeting pension incentives towards ages at which labour supply is most responsive.
title_cn: 劳动力供给与养老金缴费—受益联系
abstract_cn: 我们通过利用波兰从待遇确定型向名义确定缴费型（NDC）制度的转变，估计公共养老金激励对远离正常退休年龄的劳动供给的影响。这项改革在当期养老金缴费与未来待遇之间的联系上，制造了一个以出生队列为基础的明显断点。利用这一断点以及全体纳税人数据，我们估计出51—54岁男性相对于工作净回报的就业弹性为0.51。我们估计了一个生命周期模型以匹配这些反应，并讨论了这项改革更广泛的含义。向NDC的转变在生命周期内重新配置了工作激励，在劳动供给相对缺乏弹性的较年轻年龄增强了激励，而在劳动供给更有弹性的较年长年龄削弱了激励。这种工作激励的重新配置倾向于降低总量生命周期劳动供给，这凸显了将养老金激励瞄准劳动供给反应最大的年龄段的优势。

title: Affective Polarization, Media Outlets, and Opinion Dynamics
abstract: We study opinion dynamics in a social network consisting of two groups. Agents update their opinions by conforming to members of their own group while rejecting the views of the opposing group (affective polarization), and by listening to a media outlet that may provide biased information. We characterize the long-run opinions and identify when affective polarization and media bias lead to ideological polarization, persistent disagreement, or failures of learning. We also derive when information interventions or censorship improve the accuracy of average opinions and reduce disagreement, and when they backfire: better information helps only under specific media bias configurations and when directed to the agents we identify as most effective at propagating it through the network.
title_cn: 情感极化、媒体渠道与观点动态
abstract_cn: 我们研究一个由两个群体构成的社交网络中的意见动态。经济主体通过顺从本群体成员、同时排斥对立群体的观点（情感极化）来更新自己的意见，并倾听可能提供有偏信息的媒体渠道。我们刻画长期意见，并识别情感极化与媒体偏差在何种条件下导致意识形态极化、持续分歧或学习失败。我们还推导出信息干预或审查在何种条件下提高平均意见的准确性并减少分歧，以及在何种条件下产生反效果：更好的信息仅在特定的媒体偏差配置下、且在被我们识别为最能在网络中传播该信息的那些经济主体中才有所帮助。

title: Recruiting Talent
abstract: We study a parsimonious model of a competitive labour market in which firms privately screen workers to identify talent. The equilibrium exhibits dispersion in wages and productivity; when talent is scarce, firms with superior screening skills post higher wages, attract better applicants, and recruit more talented workers. High-wage firms impose a compositional externality on low-wage firms, leading to equilibrium inefficiency: Welfare would be higher if low-skilled firms posted high wages and selected first. We also provide a micro-foundation for firms' heterogeneous screening skills. When talented workers are better at screening (e.g. via superior referrals), a dynamic version of the economy converges to a unique steady state in which differences in talent, profits and screening skills persist forever.
title_cn: 招募人才
abstract_cn: 我们研究一个竞争性劳动力市场的简约模型，其中企业私下筛选工人以识别人才。均衡表现出工资和生产率上的分散；当人才稀缺时，筛选能力更强的企业发布更高工资，吸引更好的申请者，并招募到更有才华的工人。高工资企业对低工资企业施加了构成性外部性，导致均衡无效率：如果低技能企业发布高工资并优先筛选，福利会更高。我们还为企业异质的筛选能力提供了微观基础。当有才华的工人更擅长筛选（例如通过更优质的推荐）时，该经济的动态版本会收敛到一个唯一稳态，其中人才、利润和筛选能力的差异永远持续。

title: The Employment Effects of a Guaranteed Income: Experimental Evidence from Two U.S. States
abstract: We study the causal effects of income on a rich array of employment outcomes, leveraging an experiment in which 1,000 low-income individuals were randomized into receiving $1,000 per month unconditionally for three years, with a control group of 2,000 participants receiving $50/month. We gather detailed survey data, administrative records, and data from a mobile phone app. The transfer caused total individual income excluding the transfers to fall by about $1,900/year relative to the control group and a 4.2 percentage point decrease in labor market participation. Participants reduced their work hours as a result of the transfers by 1–2 hours/week and participants’ partners reduced their work hours by a comparable amount. Among other categories of time use, the greatest increase generated by the transfer was in time spent on leisure. Despite asking detailed questions about amenities, we find no effect on quality of employment, and our confidence intervals can rule out even small improvements. Treated participants broadly increase expenditures, led by spending on nondurable goods and services, with smaller increases in spending on durable goods and human capital. We observe no significant effects on degree attainment, though the magnitudes of the estimated effects generally appear larger among younger participants. Measures of subjective well-being are higher among treated participants in the first year of the transfers but then revert to control-group levels. Overall, our results suggest a moderate labor supply effect that does not appear offset by other productive activities.
title_cn: 保障性收入的就业效应：来自美国两个州的实验证据
abstract_cn: 我们研究收入对一系列丰富就业结果的因果效应，利用一项实验：1,000 名低收入个体被随机分配为无条件每月领取 1,000 美元、持续三年，对照组 2,000 名参与者每月领取 50 美元。我们收集了详细的调查数据、行政记录以及来自一款手机应用的数据。该转移支付导致剔除转移支付后的个人总收入相对于对照组下降约 1,900 美元/年，并使劳动力市场参与率下降 4.2 个百分点。参与者因该转移支付而减少了工作时间，每周减少 1—2 小时，参与者的伴侣也减少了大致相当的工作时间。在其他时间使用类别中，该转移支付带来的最大增幅是休闲时间。尽管我们询问了关于工作福利的详细问题，但未发现对就业质量的影响，且我们的置信区间可以排除即使很小的改善。处理组参与者总体上增加了支出，其中以非耐用品和服务支出为主，耐用品和人力资本支出的增幅较小。我们未观察到对学位获得有显著影响，尽管估计效应的大小在较年轻参与者中通常显得更大。在转移支付的第一年，处理组参与者的主观幸福感指标更高，但随后回落至对照组水平。总体而言，我们的结果表明存在适度的劳动力供给效应，且该效应似乎并未被其他生产性活动所抵消。

title: An Optimal Test for Strategic Interaction in Network Formation Games
abstract: Consider a setting where N players, partitioned into K observable types, form a directed network. Agents’ preferences over the form of the network consist of an arbitrary network benefit function (e.g. agents may have preferences over their network centrality) and a private, or dyadic, component which is additively separable in own links. This latter component allows for unobserved heterogeneity in the costs of sending and receiving links across agents (respectively out- and in- degree heterogeneity) as well as homophily/heterophily across the K types of agents. In contrast, the network benefit function allows agents’ preferences over links to vary with the presence or absence of links elsewhere in the network (and hence with the link formation behavior of their peers). In the null model, which excludes the network benefit function, links form independently across dyads in the manner described by Charbonneau, 2017, Econometrics Journal, 20, S1–S13 among others. Under the alternative, there is interdependence across linking decisions (i.e. strategic interaction). We show how to test the null with power optimized in specific directions. These alternative directions include many common models of strategic network formation (e.g. “connections” models, “structural hole” models etc.). Our random utility specification induces an exponential family structure under the null which we exploit to construct a similar test which exactly controls size (despite the the null being a composite one with many nuisance parameters). We further show how to construct locally best tests for specific alternatives without making any assumptions about equilibrium selection. To make our tests feasible, we introduce a new MCMC algorithm for simulating the null distributions of our test statistics.
title_cn: 网络形成博弈中策略互动的最优检验
abstract_cn: 考虑一个由N个参与者组成的设定，这些参与者被划分为K个可观测类型，并形成一个有向网络。经济主体对网络形式的偏好由两部分构成：一是任意的网络收益函数（例如，经济主体可能对其网络中心性有偏好），二是私人成分或二元成分，后者在自身连接上具有可加可分性。后一成分允许发送和接收连接成本在主体之间存在不可观测的异质性（分别为出度和入度异质性），以及K个类型主体之间的同质性/异质性。相比之下，网络收益函数允许经济主体对连接的偏好随网络中其他位置连接的存在或缺失而变化（因而随其同伴的连接形成行为而变化）。在零模型中——该模型排除了网络收益函数——连接按照Charbonneau（2017, Econometrics Journal, 20, S1–S13）等人所描述的方式在各二元组之间独立形成。在备择模型下，连接决策之间存在相互依赖（即策略互动）。我们展示了如何在特定方向上以最优功效检验零模型。这些备择方向包括许多常见的策略网络形成模型（例如“连接”模型、“结构洞”模型等）。我们的随机效用设定在零模型下诱导出指数族结构，我们利用该结构构造一个相似检验，该检验能够精确控制检验水平（尽管零模型是一个包含许多冗余参数的复合零模型）。我们进一步展示了如何在不 equilibrium 选择做任何假设的情况下，为特定备择模型构造局部最优检验。为使检验可行，我们引入一种新的MCMC算法来模拟检验统计量的零分布。

title: Capital Unemployment
abstract: This paper studies the unemployment of physical capital—defined as idle units searching to be traded—and its macroeconomic implications. I provide evidence documenting that capital unemployment is large, volatile, and increases during economic downturns. I construct a capital-accumulation model that explains these patterns, with trading frictions in capital markets, which give rise to equilibrium capital unemployment, and financial shocks, which lead to large fluctuations in trading probabilities and capital unemployment. Using the model, I show that trading frictions and capital unemployment matter for aggregate dynamics. First, unemployed capital affects aggregate investment dynamics: Downturns characterized by large increases in unemployed capital are followed by investment slumps, because the economy tends to recover by absorbing existing unemployed capital rather than by producing new capital goods. Second, capital unemployment constitutes a propagation mechanism from financial shocks to economic activity, which shows up at the aggregate level as measured total factor productivity.
title_cn: 资本失业
abstract_cn: 本文研究物质资本的失业——定义为闲置单位寻找交易机会——及其宏观经济含义。我提供的证据表明，资本失业规模大、波动性强，并在经济下行期间上升。我构建了一个资本积累模型来解释这些模式，该模型包含资本市场中的交易摩擦——其导致均衡资本失业——以及金融冲击——其导致交易概率和资本失业的大幅波动。利用该模型，我表明交易摩擦和资本失业对总量动态具有重要影响。第一，失业资本影响总量投资动态：以失业资本大幅增加为特征的下行期之后会出现投资低迷，因为经济往往通过吸收现有失业资本而非生产新资本品来实现复苏。第二，资本失业构成了从金融冲击到经济活动的传导机制，这在总量层面上表现为测得的全要素生产率。

title: Informative Certification: Screening versus Acquisition
abstract: We study monopolistic certification in markets where sellers possess partial private information about product quality. A certifier can provide information through two channels: screening sellers’ private information (soft information) and acquiring new quality data (hard information). We prove that any certification menu achieving less than maximal screening is Pareto dominated by one with full screening. Among Pareto-efficient menus, the certifier’s profit-maximizing menu provides maximal soft information while restricting hard information provision. The two channels diverge because screening creates value the certifier can fully capture, whereas hard information amplifies costly information rents. Using power value functions, we derive comparative statics showing that information restrictions target low-quality sellers when information value is moderate, but high-quality sellers receive perfect quality revelation when information value is high.
title_cn: 信息性认证：筛选还是获取
abstract_cn: 我们研究卖方对产品质量拥有部分私人信息时的垄断性认证。认证机构可以通过两种渠道提供信息：筛选卖方的私人信息（软信息）以及获取新的质量数据（硬信息）。我们证明，任何未达到最大筛选程度的认证菜单都被完全筛选的菜单帕累托占优。在帕累托有效的菜单中，利润最大化的菜单提供最大程度的软信息，同时限制硬信息的提供。两种渠道之所以出现分化，是因为筛选所创造的价值可被认证机构完全攫取，而硬信息则会放大代价高昂的信息租金。利用幂值函数，我们推导出比较静态结果，表明当信息价值处于中等水平时，信息限制针对的是低质量卖方，而当信息价值较高时，高质量卖方则获得完全的质量揭示。

title: Embracing the Enemy
abstract: A principal (such as a centrist political party) can partially influence the allocation of power between two competing parties. The principal is closer to one party, the “Friend”, than to the other, the “Enemy”. The principal’s optimal contract initially seeks to exclude the Enemy. However, once the Enemy gains power, the principal embraces him in exchange for policy moderation. Moderation also disciplines the Friend, inducing him to move closer to the principal’s preferred policy. Principals close to the Friend fully embrace the Enemy; more centrist principals divide their support. Commitment benefits the principal only if she is close to the Friend and parties value power little.

title: How You Pay Drives What You Choose: Mental Accounting in Health Insurance Plan Choice
abstract: We document that the source of funds for paying health insurance premiums has a dramatic impact on plan choices. We focus on the MediSave programme in Singapore, a medical savings account that is used to pay out-of-pocket medical spending. Residents can also pay their health insurance premiums with cash or MediSave funds, but are subject to limits that vary by age and over time. By exploiting variations in those limits, we consistently find that when individuals are able to pay their health insurance premiums with MediSave funds, they are less price sensitive and more willing to enrol in more generous plans. We develop and estimate a mental accounting model which explains these patterns. We embed and reject alternative explanations such as hassle costs and liquidity constraints. We then extend this model and show that mental accounting can explain much, but not all, of the misweighting of premiums relative to out-of-pocket expenses in health insurance choice. We also find that allowing MediSave payment for both premiums and out-of-pocket expenses (e.g. putting them in the same mental account) enhances individual welfare and reduces adverse selection.
title_cn: 你的支付方式如何驱动你的选择：医疗保险计划选择中的心理账户
abstract_cn: 我们记录了支付医疗保险保费的资金来源对计划选择产生的显著影响。我们聚焦于新加坡的MediSave计划，这是一个用于支付自付医疗支出的医疗储蓄账户。居民也可以用现金或MediSave资金支付医疗保险保费，但受到随年龄和时间变化的限额约束。通过利用这些限额的变动，我们一致地发现，当个人能够用MediSave资金支付医疗保险保费时，他们对价格不那么敏感，更愿意加入保障更慷慨的计划。我们构建并估计了一个心理账户模型来解释这些模式。我们嵌入并拒绝了诸如麻烦成本和流动性约束等替代解释。随后我们扩展该模型并表明，心理账户可以解释医疗保险选择中保费相对于自付费用被错误加权的大部分但并非全部现象。我们还发现，允许MediSave同时支付保费和自付费用（例如将它们放入同一心理账户）会提高个人福利并减少逆向选择。

title: College, Cognitive Ability, and Socioeconomic Disadvantage: Policy Lessons from the U.K. in 1960–2004
abstract: University access has significantly expanded in OECD countries, and further growth figures prominently in political agendas. We study possible consequences of historical and future expansions in a stochastic, general equilibrium Roy model where tertiary educational attainment is determined by cognitive ability and socioeconomic disadvantage. In our analysis, individual productivity depends not only on education but also directly on cognitive ability. The expansion of university access in the U.K. that started in the 1960s provides an ideal case study to draw lessons for the future. We find that this expansion led to the selection into college of progressively less talented students from advantaged backgrounds. Appropriate counterfactual policies existed that would have achieved the dual goal of increasing college graduates’ cognitive ability while improving tertiary education opportunities for the disadvantaged.
title_cn: 大学、认知能力与社会经济劣势：1960—2004 年英国的政策启示
abstract_cn: 经合组织国家的大学入学机会显著扩大，进一步扩张在政治议程中占据重要位置。我们在一个随机一般均衡 Roy 模型中研究历史扩张与未来扩张的可能后果，其中高等教育 attainment 由认知能力和社会经济劣势决定。在我们的分析中，个体生产率不仅取决于教育，还直接取决于认知能力。英国自 1960 年代开始的大学入学机会扩张为汲取未来经验提供了理想的案例研究。我们发现，这一扩张导致来自优势背景、天赋 progressively 较低的学生被选入大学。存在适当的反事实政策，本可实现既提高大学毕业生认知能力、又改善弱势群体高等教育机会的双重目标。

title: Clause and Effect: Theory and Field Experimental Evidence on Noncompete Clauses
abstract: We study worker noncompete clauses in a large field experiment with two finance firms. Across ~14,000 job offers to freelance recruiters on short-term contracts, we randomize wages and the presence, salience, and duration of noncompetes (all contracts also included a nondisclosure agreement). Removing a noncompete increases mobility between competing employers by 36%–52% and raises workers’ total earnings from the two firms by 12%–17%. We find no evidence—rejecting even small effects—that removing noncompetes generates secret leakage. We also find no evidence that workers choose noncompete jobs for higher pay. Many workers appear unaware of noncompetes before firms’ post-employment communication. The results align with a model of inattention and uncertainty about enforcement.
title_cn: 条款与效应：竞业限制条款的理论与田野实验证据
abstract_cn: 我们在一项与两家金融企业合作的大型田野实验中研究劳动者的竞业限制条款。针对约14,000份向短期合同自由招聘人员发出的工作邀约，我们随机化工资以及竞业限制条款的存在、显著性和期限（所有合同均同时包含保密协议）。取消竞业限制使竞争性雇主之间的流动性提高36%–52%，并使劳动者从两家企业获得的总收入提高12%–17%。我们没有发现任何证据——甚至能够排除很小的效应——表明取消竞业限制会导致秘密泄露。我们也没有发现劳动者为获得更高薪酬而选择含竞业限制岗位的证据。许多劳动者在企业于雇佣关系结束后进行沟通之前似乎并未意识到竞业限制的存在。这些结果与一个关于注意力不足和对可执行性不确定的模型相一致。

title: Marriage, Assortative Mating, and Wealth Inequality
abstract: We use population data on capital income and wealth holdings for Norway to measure asset positions and wealth returns before individuals marry and after the household is formed. These data allow us to establish a number of novel facts. First, individuals sort on personal wealth rather than parental wealth. Second, people match also on their personal returns to wealth, and assortative mating on returns is as strong as that on wealth. Third, post-marriage returns on family wealth reflect in equal part the pre-marriage returns of the two spouses. However, for households at the top of the wealth distribution at marriage, family wealth is largely managed by the spouse with the highest potential to grow it, providing a microfoundation for the scale dependence in wealth returns documented in several empirical papers. Fourth, marriage lowers the degree of wealth inequality as well as the heterogeneity in returns relative to the counterfactual case of no marriages. We use a simple framework to illustrate how the inequality-attenuating role of marriage is affected by assortative mating on wealth and returns and by wealth management task allocation between spouses.
title_cn: 婚姻、同质婚配与财富不平等
abstract_cn: 我们使用挪威的资本收入和财富持有总体数据，衡量个人在结婚前以及家庭形成后的资产头寸和财富收益率。这些数据使我们能够确立若干新的事实。第一，个体按个人财富而非父母财富进行匹配。第二，人们也按个人财富收益率进行匹配，且按收益率进行的选型婚配强度与按财富进行的选型婚配强度相当。第三，婚后家庭财富的收益率同等程度地反映了夫妻双方婚前的收益率。然而，对于结婚时处于财富分布顶端的家庭，家庭财富主要由最有潜力使其增值的一方管理，这为若干实证论文所记录的财富收益率规模依赖性提供了微观基础。第四，与无婚姻的反事实情形相比，婚姻降低了财富不平等程度以及收益率的异质性。我们用一个简单框架来说明，婚姻的不平等削弱作用如何受到按财富和收益率的选型婚配以及夫妻间财富管理任务分配的影响。

title: Foreign Exchange Intervention with UIP and CIP Deviations
abstract: We examine the welfare-based opportunity cost of foreign exchange (FX) intervention when both covered interest rate parity (CIP) and uncovered interest rate parity (UIP) deviations are present. We consider a small open economy that receives international capital flows through constrained international financial intermediaries. Deviations from CIP come from limited arbitrage or through a convenience yield, while UIP deviations are also affected by global risk. We show that the sign of CIP and UIP deviations may differ for safe haven countries. We find that FX reserves may provide a net benefit, rather than a cost, when international intermediaries value the safe-haven properties of a currency more than domestic households. We show that this has been the case for the Swiss franc and the Japanese Yen. We examine the optimal policy of a constrained central bank planner in this context.
title_cn: 在未抵补利率平价与抵补利率平价偏离下的外汇干预
abstract_cn: 我们考察在抵补利率平价（CIP）与未抵补利率平价（UIP）偏离同时存在时，外汇（FX）干预基于福利的机会成本。我们考虑一个通过受约束的国际金融中介获得国际资本流动的小型开放经济体。CIP 偏离来自有限套利或便利收益率，而 UIP 偏离还受到全球风险的影响。我们表明，对于避风港国家，CIP 与 UIP 偏离的符号可能不同。我们发现，当国际中介比国内家庭更看重某种货币的避风港属性时，外汇储备可能带来净收益而非成本。我们表明，瑞士法郎和日元的情况正是如此。我们考察了这一背景下受约束的中央银行计划者的最优政策。

title: Optimal Age-Based Policies for Pandemics: An Economic Analysis of COVID-19 and Beyond
abstract: This paper investigates the importance of the age composition for pandemic policy design. To do so, it introduces an economic framework with age heterogeneity, individual choice, and incomplete information, emphasising the value of testing. Calibrating the model to the U.S. COVID-19 pandemic reveals an 80% reduction in the death toll due to voluntary actions and the lockdown implemented in the US. The optimal lockdown, however, is more stringent than what was implemented. Moreover, the social planner follows an asymmetric approach by locking down the young relatively more than the old. We highlight the role of testing in reducing deaths, lowering economic costs, and allowing for a less restrictive lockdown. A social planner would choose a faster ramp-up in testing capacity relative to what occurred in the US. We use the framework to provide insights into pandemics caused by different viruses (including the Spanish flu) and underline the influence of economic conditions on optimal policies.
title_cn: 大流行病的最优年龄别政策：对COVID-19及以后的经济学分析
abstract_cn: 本文研究了年龄构成对于大流行病政策设计的重要性。为此，本文引入一个包含年龄异质性、个体选择和不完全信息的经济框架，并强调检测的价值。将模型校准至美国 COVID-19 大流行后发现，自愿行为和美国实施的封锁使死亡人数减少了 80%。然而，最优封锁比实际实施的封锁更为严格。此外，社会计划者采取非对称策略，对年轻人的封锁相对多于老年人。我们强调检测在降低死亡、减少经济成本和允许实施限制较少的封锁方面的作用。相对于美国实际发生的情况，社会计划者会选择更快地提升检测能力。我们运用该框架为不同病毒（包括西班牙流感）引起的大流行病提供洞见，并强调经济状况对最优政策的影响。

title: Community Engagement and Public Safety: Evidence from Crime Enforcement Targeting Immigrants
abstract: We study the role of victim reporting in the production of public safety. We examine the Secure Communities program, a crime-reduction policy that involved police in detecting unauthorized immigrants and increased deportation fears in immigrant communities. We find that the policy reduced the likelihood that Hispanic victims report crimes to police and increased offending against Hispanics. The number of reported crimes is unchanged, masking these opposing effects. We show that reduced reporting drives the offending increase and provide the first elasticity of offending to victim reporting in the literature, calculating that a 10 percent decline in reporting increases offending by 7.9 percent. (JEL J15, K37, K42)
title_cn: 社区参与与公共安全：来自针对移民的犯罪执法的证据
abstract_cn: 我们研究受害者报案在公共安全供给中的作用。我们考察“安全社区”计划，这是一项减少犯罪的举措，该政策让警察参与识别无合法身份的移民，并加剧了移民社区对遣返的恐惧。我们发现，该政策降低了西班牙裔受害者向警方报案的可能性，并增加了针对西班牙裔的犯罪行为。报案犯罪数量保持不变，掩盖了这些方向相反的效果。我们表明，报案减少推动了犯罪行为增加，并给出了文献中首个犯罪行为对受害者报案的弹性，计算得出报案下降10%会使犯罪行为增加7.9%。（JEL J15、K37、K42）

title: Additionality and Asymmetric Information in Environmental Markets: Evidence from Conservation Auctions
abstract: Mechanisms that aim to reduce environmental degradation at low cost can be undermined when participants' conservation actions are not marginal to the incentive—or “additional”—as the lowest-cost participants may not be the highest social value. We investigate this challenge in the Conservation Reserve Program's auction mechanism for ecosystem services, linking bids to satellite-derived land use. Three-quarters of marginal auction winners are not additional. The heterogeneity in counterfactual land use introduces adverse selection. We develop a model of bidding and additionality to quantify welfare implications. Alternative auctions increase efficiency by using scoring rules that incorporate expected land use impacts. (JEL D44, D82, Q24, Q57, R14)

abstract_cn: 旨在以低成本减少环境退化的机制，在参与者的保护行动对激励而言并非边际——或并非“额外”——时可能被削弱，因为成本最低的参与者未必具有最高的社会价值。我们在保护储备计划（Conservation Reserve Program）的生态系统服务拍卖机制中研究这一挑战，将投标与卫星衍生的土地利用数据相匹配。边际拍卖获胜者中有四分之三并非额外的。反事实土地利用的异质性引入了逆向选择。我们构建了一个投标与额外性模型，以量化福利含义。替代性拍卖通过采用纳入预期土地利用影响的评分规则来提高效率。（JEL D44, D82, Q24, Q57, R14）

title: The Productivity of Professions: Evidence from the Emergency Department
abstract: This paper studies the productivity of nurse practitioners (NPs) and physicians, two professions performing overlapping tasks but with starkly different backgrounds, training, and pay. Using quasi-experimental variation in patient assignment to NPs versus physicians in Veterans Health Administration emergency departments, we find that, on average, NPs use more resources and exhibit a higher 30-day preventable hospitalization rate than physicians. However, the NP-physician performance difference varies by case complexity and severity. Importantly, even larger productivity variation exists within each profession, leading to substantial overlap between the productivity distributions of the two professions; NPs outperform physicians in 38 percent of random pairs. (JEL I11, I18, J24, J44, M53)
title_cn: 职业的生产率：来自急救服务的证据
abstract_cn: 本文研究执业护士（NP）与医生的生产率。这两类职业承担相互重叠的任务，但其背景、培训和薪酬存在显著差异。利用退伍军人健康管理局急诊科中患者被分配给NP还是医生的准实验变异，我们发现，平均而言，NP使用的资源更多，且30天可预防住院率高于医生。然而，NP与医生的绩效差异随病例复杂性和严重程度而变化。重要的是，每一职业内部的生产率差异甚至更大，导致两类职业的生产率分布存在大量重叠；在38%的随机配对中，NP的表现优于医生。（JEL I11, I18, J24, J44, M53）

title: Random Utility with Unobservable Alternatives
abstract: The random utility model (RUM), a cornerstone in economics, is typically studied under the assumption that choice frequencies of all alternatives are observable. In practice, however, some alternatives have unobservable choice frequencies and are commonly aggregated into a single category called an outside option. We study RUM in such environments and derive a finite, nonredundant system of inequality constraints on observed choice frequencies that characterizes RU-rationalizability. We show that the conventional practice of aggregating unobserved alternatives can miss key information leading to incorrect conclusions such as that observed choices are rationalizable, even when no RUM is consistent with them. (JEL D11, D44, D83)
title_cn: 不可观测选项下的随机效用
abstract_cn: 随机效用模型（RUM）是经济学的基石之一，通常在所有备选项的选择频率均可观测的假设下进行研究。然而在实践中，某些备选项的选择频率不可观测，通常被归并为一个称为外部选项的单一类别。我们研究此类环境下的RUM，并推导出关于可观测选择频率的有限、非冗余不等式约束体系，用以刻画RU-理性化。我们表明，将不可观测备选项归并的常规做法可能遗漏关键信息，从而导致错误结论，例如即使不存在与之相容的RUM，也会得出所观测选择是可理性化的结论。（JEL D11, D44, D83）

title: Designing Dynamic Reassignment Mechanisms: Evidence from GP Allocation
abstract: We study the problem of designing a dynamic reassignment mechanism when agents' preferences over objects change over time. In the context of Norway's system for (re)assigning patients to general practitioners (GPs), we provide direct evidence of misallocation under the current mechanism—patients waiting for each others' GPs, but who cannot trade—and estimate a structural model of GP-switching behavior to evaluate alternatives. Introducing top trading cycles (TTC) would, on average, reduce waiting times and increase patient welfare. However, patients endowed with less desirable GPs would be harmed. Prioritizing these patients can avoid these harms while preserving most of the gains from TTC. (JEL D82, H51, I11, I13, I18)
title_cn: 设计动态重新分配机制：来自全科医生分配的证据
abstract_cn: 我们研究当经济主体对对象的偏好随时间变化时，动态重新分配机制的设计问题。在挪威将患者（重新）分配至全科医生（GP）的体系背景下，我们提供了当前机制下错配的直接证据——患者彼此等待对方的全科医生，却无法进行交换——并估计了一个全科医生转换行为的结构模型以评估替代方案。引入最高交易循环（TTC）机制平均而言会缩短等待时间并提高患者福利。然而，初始被分配较不受欢迎的全科医生的患者会受到损害。优先考虑这些患者可以避免上述损害，同时保留 TTC 的大部分收益。（JEL D82, H51, I11, I13, I18）

title: Merger Effects and Antitrust Enforcement: Evidence from US Consumer Packaged Goods
abstract: We document the effects of a comprehensive set of mergers of consumer packaged goods manufacturers on prices, quantities, and product assortment. Across specifications, we find a small average price effect of mergers (−0.5−1.1 percent) but substantial heterogeneity, with a standard deviation between 3.9 and 7.6 percentage points. Through a model of enforcement, we find that agencies act as if they challenge mergers they expect would increase prices more than 4.8 to 6.3 percent. Increases in stringency would reduce prices and the prevalence of completed price-increasing mergers, with minimal impacts on blocked price-decreasing mergers, at significantly greater agency burden. (JEL D43, G34, K21, L13, L41, L66)
title_cn: 合并效应与反垄断执法：来自美国包装消费品的证据
abstract_cn: 我们记录了包装消费品制造商一系列全面合并对价格、数量和产品组合的影响。在不同设定下，我们发现合并的平均价格效应较小（−0.5% 至 −1.1%），但异质性显著，标准差在 3.9 至 7.6 个百分点之间。通过一个执法模型，我们发现，机构的行为方式似乎是：对于预期会使价格上涨超过 4.8% 至 6.3% 的合并，它们会提出质疑。提高执法严格程度会降低价格和已完成的价格上涨型合并的发生率，对被阻止的价格下降型合并影响极小，但会给机构带来显著更大的负担。（JEL D43, G34, K21, L13, L41, L66）

title: Energy Transitions in Regulated Markets
abstract: Natural gas has replaced coal as the dominant fuel for US electricity generation. However, utilities in regulated US states have retired coal more slowly than others. We build a structural model of rate-of-return regulation during an energy transition where utilities face trade-offs between lowering costs and maintaining and using legacy capacity. A regulated utility facing carbon taxes lowers short-run coal generation 48 percent as much as a cost minimizer would. Thirty years after a sudden energy transition, a cost minimizer has retired 71 percent more coal capacity than the regulated utility. Alternative regulations may jeopardize affordability and reliability goals during energy transitions. (JEL D24, L94, L98, Q35, Q48)
title_cn: 受监管市场中的能源转型
abstract_cn: 天然气已取代煤炭成为美国发电的主要燃料。然而，美国受监管各州的公用事业公司退役煤炭的速度慢于其他州。我们构建了一个能源转型期间收益率监管的结构模型，其中公用事业公司在降低成本与维持和使用既有产能之间面临权衡。面临碳税时，受监管的公用事业公司减少短期燃煤发电的幅度仅为成本最小化者的48%。在能源转型突然发生三十年后，成本最小化者退役的煤炭产能比受监管的公用事业公司多71%。替代性监管可能在能源转型期间危及可负担性和可靠性目标。（JEL D24, L94, L98, Q35, Q48）

title: Uncertainty and Change: Survey Evidence of Firms' Subjective Beliefs
abstract: This paper studies how managers plan under uncertainty. In a new panel survey of German manufacturing firms, we observe both forecasts of sales growth and a quantitative measure of subjective uncertainty. We show that subjective uncertainty reflects change experienced by firms: It is high when growth is either unusually low or unusually high. Subjective uncertainty is more than conditional volatility; while more volatile firms are typically more uncertain, experienced change alone increases uncertainty, consistent with a model of learning. Uncertainty over our sample is mostly idiosyncratic but varies substantially over time and leads managers to plan lower employment and prices. (JEL C83, D22, E20, E23)
title_cn: 不确定性与变化：企业主观信念的调查证据
abstract_cn: 本文研究管理者如何在不确定性下进行规划。在一项针对德国制造业企业的新面板调查中，我们同时观测到销售增长预测和主观不确定性的定量测度。我们表明，主观不确定性反映了企业所经历的变化：当增长异常低或异常高时，主观不确定性较高。主观不确定性不仅仅是条件波动率；虽然波动率更高的企业通常更不确定，但仅经历变化本身就会提高不确定性，这与学习模型相一致。在我们的样本中，不确定性主要是个体特异性的，但随时间大幅变化，并促使管理者规划更低的就业和价格。（JEL C83, D22, E20, E23）

title: Professional Motivations in the Public Sector: Evidence from Police Officers
abstract: We study how public sector workers balance their professional motivations with private economic concerns, focusing on police arrests. Arrests made near the end of an officer's shift typically require overtime work, and officers respond by reducing arrest frequency but increasing arrest quality. Days in which an officer works a second job after their police shift have higher opportunity cost, also reducing late-shift arrests. Combining our estimates in a dynamic model identifies officer preferences over workplace activity and overtime work. Our results indicate that officers' private costs of arrests have a first-order impact on the quantity and quality of enforcement. (JEL K42, J33, J45)
title_cn: 公共部门的职业动机：来自警察的证据
abstract_cn: 我们研究公共部门工作者如何在职业动机与私人经济考量之间进行权衡，并以警察逮捕行为为焦点。在警员班次临近结束时实施的逮捕通常需要加班，警员的反应是降低逮捕频率但提高逮捕质量。若警员在警察班次之后还要从事第二份工作，则当天的时间机会成本更高，这同样会减少晚班时段的逮捕。我们将各项估计结果纳入动态模型，识别出警员对工作场所活动和加班工作的偏好。结果表明，警员实施逮捕的私人成本对执法数量和质量具有一阶影响。（JEL K42、J33、J45）

title: Remote Work and City Structure
abstract: Relative to remote work, working downtown facilitates valuable interactions with other in-office workers but entails commuting costs. The resulting coordination mechanism can lead to multiple stationary equilibria with varying levels of remote work. Temporary reductions in commuters, as in the COVID-19 pandemic, can lead to persistently large fractions of remote workers. Cell phone-based mobility data for the United States shows commuting trips in the largest cities, which are more likely to exhibit multiplicity, have stabilized at only 60 percent of prepandemic levels, while they are fully back in smaller cities. Cities with permanently low commuting experience average welfare losses of 2.3 percent. (JEL I12, J22, M54, R23, R31)
title_cn: 远程工作与城市结构
abstract_cn: 相对于远程办公，在市中心办公有利于与其他到岗办公的劳动者进行有价值的互动，但会带来通勤成本。由此形成的协调机制可能导致存在多个远程办公比例不同的稳态均衡。通勤者人数的暂时减少（如新冠疫情期间）可能导致远程办公者比例持续处于较高水平。美国基于手机的出行数据表明，在更可能出现多重均衡的大城市，通勤出行仅稳定在疫情前水平的60%，而在较小城市则已完全恢复。通勤长期处于低水平的城市平均承受2.3%的福利损失。（JEL I12, J22, M54, R23, R31）

title: Talent Hoarding in Organizations
abstract: Most organizations rely on managers to identify talented workers. However, managers who are evaluated on team performance have an incentive to hoard workers. This study provides the first empirical evidence of talent hoarding using personnel records and survey evidence from a large firm. Talent hoarding is self-reported by three-fourths of managers, is detectable in manager ratings of worker talent, and occurs more frequently under stronger hoarding incentives, proxied by performance-related pay, team size, and talent visibility. Using quasi-random exposure to talent hoarding, I show that hoarding deters internal job applications, inhibiting career progression and altering talent allocation in the firm. (JEL D22, J23, L60, M12, M51, M54)
title_cn: 组织中的人才囤积
abstract_cn: 多数组织依赖管理者识别有才能的员工。然而，按团队绩效接受考核的管理者有动机囤积员工。本研究利用一家大型企业的人事记录和调查证据，首次提供了人才囤积的经验证据。四分之三的管理者自报存在人才囤积行为，该行为可在管理者对员工才能的评级中被识别，并且在更强的囤积动机下更频繁发生，这些动机以绩效相关薪酬、团队规模和人才可见性作为代理变量。利用准随机暴露于人才囤积的设定，我表明囤积会阻碍内部职位申请，抑制职业晋升并改变企业内的人才配置。（JEL D22, J23, L60, M12, M51, M54）

title: Political Parties as Drivers of U.S. Polarization: 1927-2018
abstract: The current polarization of elites in the U.S., particularly in Congress, is frequently ascribed to the emergence of cohorts of ideologically extreme legislators replacing moderate ones. Politicians, however, do not operate as isolated agents, driven solely by their preferences. They act within organized parties, whose leaders exert control over the rank-and-file, directing support for and against policies. This paper shows that the omission of party discipline as a driver of political polarization is consequential for our understanding of this phenomenon. We present a multi-dimensional voting model and identification strategy designed to decouple the ideological preferences of lawmakers from the control exerted by their party leadership. Applying this structural framework to the U.S. Congress between 1927-2018, we find that the influence of leaders over their rank-and-file has been a growing driver of polarization in voting, particularly since the 1970s. In 2018, party discipline accounts for around 65% of the polarization in roll call voting. Our findings qualify the interpretation of -and in two important cases subvert -a number of empirical claims in the literature that measures polarization with models that lack a formal role for parties.
title_cn: 政党作为美国政治极化的驱动因素：1927—2018
abstract_cn: 当前美国精英群体、尤其是国会中的极化，常被归因于意识形态极端的新一批议员取代了温和派议员。然而，政治家并非作为孤立的、仅受自身偏好驱动的经济主体行事。他们在有组织的政党中行动，政党领袖对普通议员施加控制，引导其支持或反对各项政策。本文表明，将政党纪律作为政治极化的驱动因素加以忽略，会影响我们对这一现象的理解。我们提出一个多维投票模型和识别策略，旨在将立法者的意识形态偏好与其政党领袖所施加的控制区分开来。将这一结构框架应用于1927—2018年的美国国会，我们发现领袖对普通议员的影响力日益成为投票极化的驱动因素，尤其是自20世纪70年代以来。2018年，政党纪律约占唱名投票极化的大约65%。我们的发现限定了——并在两个重要情形下颠覆了——文献中若干实证主张的解释，这些主张使用未赋予政党正式角色的模型来度量极化。

title: A Theory of Redistribution and Public Good Provision Under Non-Democracy
abstract: Two office-motivated politicians compete for power by making promises to citizens. Unlike in voting models, a citizens' political activity is observable and subject to retaliation if the citizen happens to back the wrong politician. In equilibrium, a citizen supports the politician that is expected to win the political contest, not the one who promises her the most. Consequently, the incentives for politicians to redistribute resources and provide public goods are different from those in voting models. Citizens who are better able to coordinate with others receive more resources in equilibrium. Transition to democracy is not voluntary in this model.
title_cn: 非民主体制下再分配与公共品提供的理论
abstract_cn: 两位以职位为动机的政治家通过向公民作出承诺来争夺权力。与投票模型不同，公民的政治活动是可观测的，并且如果该公民恰好支持了错误的政治家，就会遭到报复。在均衡中，公民支持的是预期将赢得政治角逐的政治家，而不是向她承诺最多利益的那一位。因此，政治家重新分配资源和提供公共品的激励与投票模型中的情形不同。更有能力与他人协调的公民在均衡中获得更多资源。在该模型中，向民主的转型并非自愿的。

title: Macro Shocks and Firm Dynamics with Oligopolistic Financial Intermediaries
abstract: Motivated by a secular increase in the concentration of the U.S. banking industry, I develop a new macroeconomic model with oligopolistic financial intermediaries and heterogeneous firms. Market power allows banks to price discriminate and charge firm-specific markups, exerting greater market power over productive and more financially constrained firms. This dampens capital accumulation and amplifies the effects of macroeconomic shocks. During a crisis, banks exploit the higher share of financially constrained firms to extract higher markups, inducing a larger decline in real activity. When a large bank fails, the remaining banks use their increased market power to restrict credit supply, worsening and prolonging the downturn.
title_cn: 宏观冲击与寡头金融中介下的企业动态
abstract_cn: 受美国银行业集中度长期上升的启发，我构建了一个包含寡头金融中介和异质性企业的新宏观经济模型。市场势力使银行能够进行价格歧视并收取企业特定加成，对生产率更高和融资约束更强的企业施加更大的市场势力。这抑制了资本积累并放大了宏观经济冲击的影响。在危机期间，银行利用融资约束企业占比上升来提取更高的加成，导致实际经济活动出现更大幅度下降。当一家大型银行倒闭时，其余银行利用其增强的市场势力限制信贷供给，使衰退恶化并延长。

title: An Evaluation of Protected Area Policies in the European Union
abstract: The European Union (EU) designates 26% of its landmass as protected areas, limiting economic development for biodiversity. We use the staggered introduction of protected areas between 1985 and 2019 to study the selection of protected land and the causal effect of protection on vegetation cover and nightlights. We find no meaningful impacts on either outcome across four decades, countries, protection cohorts, or land characteristics. These null effects are consistent with the political economy of EU land protection: weak incentives to internalize biodiversity gains, green-glow motives, and area-based targets shape local siting and stringency choices. In practice, strict protection is applied where development pressure is low–so that protection has little bite—while in high-pressure regions, protection is typically weak, imposing only limited constraints on economic activity.
title_cn: 对欧盟保护区政策的评估
abstract_cn: 欧盟将其26%的陆地面积划定为保护区，以生物多样性为由限制经济开发。我们利用1985年至2019年间保护区的交错设立，研究保护用地的选择以及保护对植被覆盖和夜间灯光的因果效应。我们发现，在四十年间、跨国家、跨保护批次或跨土地特征，对这两种结果均无实质性影响。这些零效应与欧盟土地保护的政治经济学相一致：内化生物多样性收益的激励薄弱、绿色光环动机以及基于面积的目标共同塑造了地方选址和严格程度的选择。在实践中，严格保护被施加于开发压力较低的地区——因此保护几乎没有实际约束力——而在高压力地区，保护通常较弱，仅对经济活动施加有限约束。

title: Capital Services in Global Value Chains
abstract: This article constructs the first global data set on intersectoral capital service expenditures. I use these data to disaggregate capital services and intermediate inputs in a dynamic multisector trade model. Steady-state allocations and responses to shocks are determined by a capital-augmented global input-output matrix. Two properties of the measured network deliver larger long-run consumption gains from globalization than existing estimates, as well as larger gains in more capital-intensive countries. First, more trade-exposed sectors supply capital to more consumption-influential producers. Second, heterogeneity in the network reallocates sectoral expenditures toward producers with larger declines in capital rental prices. These reallocations raise capital incomes and lower consumption price indices.
title_cn: 全球价值链中的资本服务
abstract_cn: 本文构建了首个关于跨部门资本服务支出的全球数据集。我利用这些数据在一个动态多部门贸易模型中对资本服务和中间投入进行分解。稳态配置和对冲击的响应由资本扩展型全球投入产出矩阵决定。所测度网络的两种性质带来了比现有估计更大的全球化长期消费收益，并且在资本更密集的国家带来更大的收益。第一，更多暴露于贸易的部门向对消费影响更大的生产者供给资本。第二，网络中的异质性将部门支出重新配置到资本租赁价格下降幅度更大的生产者。这些重新配置提高了资本收入并降低了消费价格指数。

title: When is Separate Sales Optimal?
abstract: This paper studies a multi-product monopolist facing a privately informed consumer with additive and type-increasing valuations. Separate monopoly pricing is robustly optimal with respect to the type distribution if and only if the marginal rate of substitution between each pair of goods is monotone. This result is obtained by extending the conventional Myersonian approach.
title_cn: 分离销售何时最优？
abstract_cn: 本文研究一个面临私人信息消费者且消费者具有可加且随类型递增估值的多产品垄断者。当且仅当任意两种商品之间的边际替代率单调时，分开的垄断定价相对于类型分布是稳健最优的。该结果通过扩展传统的 Myerson 方法得到。

title: Mental Models of the Stock Market
abstract: Investors’ return expectations are pivotal in stock markets, but the reasoning behind these expectations is not well understood. This article explores economic agents’ mental models of what drives returns. We survey the general population, retail investors, financial professionals, and academic experts to investigate how they forecast and explain future returns in scenarios with stale news about future company earnings. We find that investors strongly disagree in their forecasts and reasoning. Most academic experts view markets as efficient. By contrast, most households express a perspective we call “expected earnings reasoning”: they directly equate higher expected earnings with higher expected returns. Professionals are split between market efficiency, mispricing, and expected earnings reasoning. In detailed experiments, we dissect why households adopt expected earnings reasoning. We show that it arises from inattention to how stock price changes affect investor costs—that is, how much investors must pay to acquire a claim to future cash flows—because the typical format and context of investment problems obscure these cost implications. Our results help connect a series of previously documented anomalies in expectation and trading data and highlight the importance of selective attention and context in shaping reasoning and belief formation.
title_cn: 股票市场的心理模型
abstract_cn: 投资者的收益率预期在股票市场中至关重要，但这些预期背后的推理机制尚未得到充分理解。本文探讨经济主体关于收益率驱动因素的思维模型。我们调查了普通公众、散户投资者、金融专业人士和学术专家，考察他们在存在关于公司未来盈利的过时信息的情景下如何预测和解释未来收益率。我们发现，投资者在预测和推理上存在严重分歧。大多数学术专家将市场视为有效的。相比之下，大多数家庭表达了一种我们称之为“预期盈利推理”的视角：他们直接将更高的预期盈利等同于更高的预期收益率。专业人士则在市场有效性、错误定价和预期盈利推理之间分化。在详细的实验中，我们剖析了家庭为何采用预期盈利推理。我们表明，这一推理源于对股价变化如何影响投资者成本的忽视——即投资者为获得对未来现金流的索取权必须支付多少——因为投资问题的典型格式和语境掩盖了这些成本含义。我们的结果有助于将一系列先前记录的预期和交易数据中的异象联系起来，并凸显了选择性注意和语境在塑造推理与信念形成中的重要性。

title: The Transmission of Reliable and Unreliable Information
abstract: Information often spreads and influences beliefs regardless of its reliability. We show that this occurs in part because indicators of reliability tend to be lost in the process of word-of-mouth transmission. We conduct controlled experiments where participants listen to economic forecasts and pass them on through voice messages. Other participants listen either to original or transmitted audio recordings and report incentivized beliefs. Across various transmitter incentive schemes, a claim’s reliability is lost in transmission much more than the claim itself. Reliable and unreliable information, once filtered through transmission, affect listeners’ beliefs similarly. Mechanism experiments show that reliability is lost not because it is perceived as less relevant or harder to transmit but because it is less likely to come to mind during transmission. Evidence from our experiments, a large corpus of everyday conversations, and economic TV news shows that contextual cues can bring reliability to mind and induce its transmission, but situations in which people share information seldom contain such cues.
title_cn: 可靠信息与不可靠信息的传递
abstract_cn: 信息往往不论其可靠性如何都会传播并影响信念。我们表明，这部分是因为可靠性的指示信号在口口相传的过程中容易丢失。我们开展了控制实验，参与者收听经济预测并通过语音信息将其转发。其他参与者收听原始或转发后的音频录音，并报告有激励的信念。在各种传递者激励方案下，一项说法的可靠性在传递中丢失的程度远大于该说法本身。可靠和不可靠的信息一旦经过传递过滤，对听者信念的影响相似。机制实验表明，可靠性之所以丢失，并非因为它被视为较不相关或较难传递，而是因为它在传递过程中较不容易被想到。来自我们的实验、一个大型日常对话语料库以及经济电视新闻的证据表明，情境线索可以使可靠性被想到并促使其被传递，但人们分享信息的情境很少包含此类线索。

title: Industrial Clusters in the Long Run: Evidence from Million-Rouble Plants in China
abstract: We study the impact of large, successful manufacturing plants on other local producers in China, focusing on “Million-Rouble Plants” built in the 1950s during a brief alliance with the U.S.S.R. The ephemeral geopolitical situation and the locations of allied and enemy airbases provide exogenous variation in plant siting. We find a boom-and-bust pattern: Counties hosting these plants were 80% more productive than control counties in 1982 but 20% less productive by 2010. This decline reflects the performance of local establishments, which exhibit low productivity, limited innovation, and high markup. Specialization hindered spillovers, preventing the emergence of new clusters and local entrepreneurship.
title_cn: 从长远看产业集群：来自中国百万卢布工厂的证据
abstract_cn: 我们研究大型、成功的制造业工厂对中国其他本地生产者的影响，聚焦于20世纪50年代在与苏联短暂结盟期间建设的“百万卢布工厂”。短暂的地缘政治形势以及盟国和敌国空军基地的位置为工厂选址提供了外生变异。我们发现了一种繁荣—萧条模式：1982年，拥有这些工厂的县的生产率比控制县高80%，但到2010年则低20%。这一下降反映了本地企业的表现，这些企业表现出低生产率、有限的创新和高加成率。专业化阻碍了溢出效应，阻止了新集群和本地创业的出现。

title: The Long Shadow of Housing Discrimination: Evidence from Racial Covenants
abstract: Racial covenants in housing deeds were widely used in the United States during the early 20th century to segregate neighbourhoods. In 1948, the Supreme Court decision in Shelley v. Kraemer made racial covenants unenforceable in court, stopping short of prohibiting them entirely. We surmise that even after losing their judicial enforceability, such covenants could have shaped segregation if they served as a focal point for coordination on an initial equilibrium in neighbourhood formation, a context characterised by investment durability and path dependency. To test this hypothesis, we assemble novel parcel-level data on racial covenants and develop a quasi-experimental design that exploits delays between covenant execution and housing construction to isolate exposure to enforceable covenants at the time neighbourhoods were built. Covenant enforceability indeed affected early-stage neighbourhood formation in terms of housing characteristics, public infrastructure placement, and the composition of initial residents. These early differences proved durable: A one standard deviation increase in neighborhood exposure to enforceable covenants accounts for 6%–24% of the observed neighbourhood racial segregation from 1980 to 2020 and 3.1%–4.4% of housing price differentials in the 21st century. We conclude that by coordinating beliefs and decisions during neighbourhood formation, the law generated spatial inequality that has long outlived racial covenants themselves.
title_cn: 住房歧视的长期阴影：来自种族限制性契约的证据
abstract_cn: 20世纪初，美国住房契约中的种族限制条款被广泛用于实施社区隔离。1948年，最高法院在Shelley诉Kraemer案中裁定种族限制条款在法庭上不可执行，但并未完全禁止此类条款。我们推测，即使失去司法可执行性，如果这些条款在社区形成过程中充当了围绕初始均衡进行协调的焦点，那么在投资持久性和路径依赖特征显著的背景下，它们仍可能塑造隔离格局。为检验这一假说，我们汇编了关于种族限制条款的新型地块层面数据，并设计了一种准实验方法，利用条款签署与住房建设之间的时间差，分离出社区建成时暴露于可执行条款的影响。条款的可执行性确实在住房特征、公共基础设施布局以及初始居民构成方面影响了早期社区形成。这些早期差异被证明具有持久性：社区暴露于可执行条款的程度每增加一个标准差，可解释1980年至2020年间观测到的社区种族隔离的6%–24%，以及21世纪住房价格差异的3.1%–4.4%。我们得出结论：通过在社区形成过程中协调信念和决策，法律产生了空间不平等，其影响远远超出了种族限制条款本身。

title: Smooth Diagnostic Expectations
abstract: We show that the formalization of representativeness (Kahneman and Tversky, 1972, Cognitive Psychology, 3, 430–454) developed by Gennaioli and Shleifer (2010, The Quarterly Journal of Economics, 125, 1399–1433) features an intrinsic connection between uncertainty and overreaction. In the time series domain, we develop this connection in a smooth version of diagnostic expectations (DE), where overreaction varies smoothly with uncertainty. Intuitively, under smoothness, lower uncertainty leaves less room for representativeness to distort beliefs. Smooth DE provides a joint, parsimonious micro-foundation for key features of survey data: overreaction to news, stronger overreaction at longer horizons, overconfidence in subjective uncertainty, and a new stylized fact documented here—overreaction intensifies with higher uncertainty. An analytical Real Business Cycle model with Smooth DE accounts for survey overreaction and overconfidence, as well as three salient business cycle properties: asymmetry, countercyclical macro volatility, and countercyclical micro volatility.
title_cn: 平滑诊断预期
abstract_cn: 我们表明，Gennaioli 和 Shleifer（2010，The Quarterly Journal of Economics，125，1399–1433）所发展的代表性（Kahneman 和 Tversky，1972，Cognitive Psychology，3，430–454）形式化，具有不确定性与过度反应之间的内在联系。在时间序列领域，我们在诊断性预期（DE）的平滑版本中发展了这一联系，其中过度反应随不确定性平滑变化。直观上，在平滑性下，较低的不确定性留给代表性扭曲信念的空间更小。平滑 DE 为调查数据的关键特征提供了一个联合、简约的微观基础：对新闻的过度反应、较长预测期上更强的过度反应、对主观不确定性的过度自信，以及本文记录的一个新典型事实——过度反应随不确定性升高而加剧。一个带有平滑 DE 的解析实际经济周期模型能够解释调查中的过度反应与过度自信，以及三个显著的商业周期特征：不对称性、逆周期的宏观波动性和逆周期的微观波动性。

title: The Selective Disclosure of Evidence: An Experiment
abstract: We conduct an experimental analysis of selective disclosure in communication. In the model, an informed sender aims to influence a receiver by disclosing verifiable evidence that is selected from a larger pool of available evidence. Our experimental design leverages this model’s rich comparative statics, allowing us to systematically quantify the effects of selection relative to concealment. Our findings confirm the key qualitative predictions of the theory, suggesting that selection, rather than concealment, is often the dominant distortion in communication. We also identify deviations from the theory: Some senders are “deception averse” and overcommunicate relative to predictions; receivers respond too optimistically to both concealed and selected evidence, with errors of similar magnitude. Yet selection generates greater overall distortion in receiver behaviour because it is far more prevalent than concealment.
title_cn: 证据的选择性披露：一项实验
abstract_cn: 我们对沟通中的选择性披露进行了实验分析。在该模型中，掌握信息的发送者通过从更大的可用证据池中选取可验证证据进行披露，以影响接收者。我们的实验设计利用该模型丰富的比较静态结果，从而能够系统量化选择相对于隐瞒的影响。我们的发现证实了该理论的关键定性预测，表明在沟通中，选择而非隐瞒往往是主要的扭曲来源。我们还识别出与理论的偏离：部分发送者具有“欺骗厌恶”，相对于预测而言过度沟通；接收者对隐瞒证据和选择证据的反应都过于乐观，且误差幅度相近。然而，选择在接收者行为中产生的总体扭曲更大，因为其远比隐瞒更为普遍。

title: Structural Change in Production Networks and Economic Growth
abstract: We study structural change in production networks for intermediate inputs (input–output network) and new capital (investment network). For each network, we document that the share of output produced by services (relative to goods) is rising over time. While the relative prices of services that produce intermediates and consumption are rising, we find that the relative price of services that produce investment is falling over time. We then develop a multi-sector growth model to study these trends and their implications for economic growth. To match the relative price trends, inputs to intermediates production are complements and inputs to investment production are substitutes. Hence, structural change endogenously reallocates resources to the slowest growing intermediates producers and the fastest growing investment producers. Growth accounting exercises reveal that investment-specific technical change accounts for an increasing share of U.S. aggregate growth, with 20% of aggregate growth since 2000 due to investment structural change. Growth projections from our model show that structural change within investment networks alone can offset stagnating or declining growth in other sectors due to Baumol’s cost disease.
title_cn: 生产网络中的结构变化与经济增长
abstract_cn: 我们研究中间投入品（投入—产出网络）和新资本（投资网络）生产网络中的结构变化。对每个网络，我们记录到服务业（相对于商品）生产的产出份额随时间上升。尽管生产中间投入品和消费品的服务相对价格在上升，我们发现生产投资品的服务相对价格随时间下降。随后我们构建一个多部门增长模型来研究这些趋势及其对经济增长的含义。为匹配相对价格趋势，中间投入品生产的投入品为互补品，投资品生产的投入品为替代品。因此，结构变化内生地将资源重新配置到增长最慢的中间投入品生产者和增长最快的投资品生产者。增长核算 exercise 显示，投资特定技术变化占美国总量增长的份额不断上升，2000 年以来总量增长的 20% 归因于投资结构变化。我们模型的增长预测显示，仅投资网络内部的结构变化就可以抵消其他部门因 Baumol 成本病而出现的增长停滞或下降。

title: A Model of the Data Economy
abstract: In a data economy, transactions of goods and services generate data, which is stored, traded and depreciates. How are the economics of this economy different from traditional production economies? How do these differences matter for measurement of GDP, firm values, depreciation rates, welfare and externalities? We incorporate active experimentation and data as an intangible asset to devise a tractable recursive representation of the data economy. The model rationalizes why apps are often “free” and why even non-digital economic activity might be greater than GDP suggests. Calibrating the model using a combination of macroeconomic and financial moments suggests that the mis-measurement in U.S. GDP due to missing value of data has been as high as 6% in 2018.
title_cn: 数据经济的一个模型
abstract_cn: 在数据经济中，商品和服务交易会产生数据，数据被存储、交易并折旧。这一经济体的经济学与传统生产经济体有何不同？这些差异对GDP、企业价值、折旧率、福利和外部性的测度有何影响？我们将主动实验和数据作为一种无形资产纳入模型，构建了数据经济的易处理递归表示。该模型解释了为何应用程序往往“免费”，以及为何即使非数字经济活动也可能大于GDP所显示的水平。结合宏观经济与金融矩条件对模型进行校准后表明，由于数据价值缺失，2018年美国GDP的测度误差高达6%。

title: How Do People React to Income-Based Fines? Evidence from Speeding Tickets Discontinuities
abstract: This article studies the impact of income-based criminal punishments on crime. In Finland, speeding tickets become income-dependent if the driver’s speed exceeds the speeding limit by more than 20 km/h, leading to a substantial jump in the size of the speeding ticket. Contrary to predictions of a traditional Becker model, individuals do not bunch below the fine hike. Instead, the speeding distributions are smooth at the cutoff. However, I demonstrate that the size of the realized speeding ticket has sizable, but short-lived, impacts on reoffending. I use a regression discontinuity design to show that fines that are, on average, 200 euros larger decrease reoffending by 15% in the following 6 months. The drop in reoffending is driven by high-income individuals facing the highest fine at the cutoff. I estimate that a fixed fine hike that matches the current deterrence effect would raise the fine increase faced by the bottom income quartile by about 300% at the cutoff, relative to the increase they face under the current income-based schedule. My empirical results are consistent with an explanation that people operate under information frictions. To illustrate this, I construct a Becker model with misperception and learning that can explain all the empirical findings.
title_cn: 人们如何对基于收入的罚款作出反应？来自超速罚单断点的证据
abstract_cn: 本文研究基于收入的刑事处罚对犯罪的影响。在芬兰，当驾驶员的超速幅度超过限速 20 公里/小时以上时，超速罚单金额转为取决于收入，导致超速罚单金额大幅跃升。与传统贝克尔模型的预测相反，个人并不会在罚款跃升点以下扎堆。相反，超速分布在临界点处是平滑的。然而，我证明实际开出的超速罚单金额对再犯具有可观但短暂的影响。我使用回归断点设计表明，平均高出 200 欧元的罚款使随后 6 个月内的再犯率下降 15%。再犯率的下降由在临界点面临最高罚款的高收入个人所驱动。我估计，若采用固定罚款上调幅度以匹配当前的威慑效应，则最低收入四分位群体在临界点面临的罚款增幅将比现行基于收入的罚款标准下其所面临的增幅高出约 300%。我的实证结果与人们处于信息摩擦之下的解释相一致。为说明这一点，我构建了一个包含错误感知与学习的贝克尔模型，该模型能够解释所有实证发现。

title: In Their Shoes: Empathy Through Information
abstract: We explore the mechanics of empathy. We show that information about an outgroup can activate and magnify empathy when presented in conjunction with an experience simulating their struggles. This response increases the willingness to help the struggling group. We provide evidence for this effect in an immersive virtual reality experiment where participants (witnesses) experience a simulation of the struggle of unauthorized migrants (protagonists), then replicate these results in a series of controlled lab experiments. We show that information enhances the witnesses’ empathetic response and drives them to engage in more prosocial behavior when it increases their perceived interpersonal similarity, or relatability to the protagonist—an effect we trace to attention: eye-tracking data reveal that information provision concentrates witnesses’ gaze on the struggles of the protagonist instead of searching through peripheral elements of the scene. Conversely, only information packages that strengthen perceived relatability—an effect that can vary across subgroups with heterogeneous attributes—magnify empathy. Together, our evidence suggests that the ability to put oneself in the shoes of another person or group can be enhanced by activating empathy through simple, targeted, information provision.
title_cn: 设身处地：通过信息实现共情
abstract_cn: 我们探讨共情的机制。我们表明，当关于外群体（outgroup）的信息与模拟其困境的体验同时呈现时，这些信息能够激活并放大共情。这一反应会提高帮助该困境群体的意愿。我们在一项沉浸式虚拟现实实验中为该效应提供了证据：参与者（见证者）体验对无证移民（主角）困境的模拟，随后我们在一系列受控实验室实验中复制了这些结果。我们表明，当信息提高见证者感知到的人际相似性，即与主角的可关联性时，信息会增强见证者的共情反应，并促使他们采取更多亲社会行为——我们将这一效应追溯到注意力：眼动追踪数据显示，信息提供使见证者的注视集中于主角的困境，而非在场景的边缘元素中搜寻。相反，只有强化感知可关联性的信息组合——这一效应可能因属性异质的子群体而不同——才会放大共情。综合来看，我们的证据表明，通过简单、有针对性的信息提供来激活共情，可以增强设身处地理解他人或其他群体的能力。

title: Subjective Earnings Risk
abstract: We introduce a survey instrument to measure earnings risk allowing for the possibility of quitting or being fired from the current job. We find these transitions to be the key drivers of subjective risk. A link with administrative data provides multiple credibility checks and reveals that subjective earnings risk varies systematically across the population. It is also many times smaller than traditional estimates even when conditioning richly on demographics and job history. We show that subjective earnings risk can help explain why many hold limited liquid assets.
title_cn: 主观收入风险
abstract_cn: 我们引入一种调查工具来测度收入风险，并允许从当前工作辞职或被解雇的可能性。我们发现这些转换是主观风险的关键驱动因素。与行政数据的链接提供了多重可信性检验，并揭示主观收入风险在人群中存在系统性差异。即使对人口特征和工作经历进行充分条件控制，它也比传统估计小许多倍。我们表明，主观收入风险有助于解释为何许多人持有的流动性资产有限。

title: Global Working Hours
abstract: This article uses labor force surveys from 160 countries to build a new microdatabase on hours worked covering 97% of the world population in cross section. We also construct time series spanning over 20 years in 86 countries. Hours worked per adult slightly decline with GDP per capita but are weakly correlated with development overall. Hours worked by the young (aged 15–19) and elderly (aged 60+) fall with development, driven entirely by growing school attendance and public pension coverage. Hours worked among prime-age adults (aged 20–59) are stable with development but undergo a great gender reshuffling: falling hours per male worker have been exactly offset by increases in female labor force participation in many countries. Labor income taxes are strongly negatively related to hours worked across countries. This correlation is attenuated when controlling for social spending and disappears when further controlling for working hours regulations. Both social spending and working hours regulations are associated with lower hours worked.
title_cn: 全球工作时间
abstract_cn: 本文利用160个国家的劳动力调查数据，构建了一个新的工作时长微观数据库，横截面覆盖全球97%的人口。我们还构建了86个国家跨度超过20年的时间序列。成年人人均工作时长随人均GDP略有下降，但总体上与发展水平的相关性较弱。年轻群体（15—19岁）和老年群体（60岁及以上）的工作时长随发展水平下降，这完全由入学率上升和公共养老金覆盖扩大所驱动。壮年成年人（20—59岁）的工作时长随发展水平保持稳定，但经历了显著的性别重组：在许多国家，男性劳动者人均工作时长的下降恰好被女性劳动力参与率的上升所抵消。各国劳动所得税与工作时长呈强烈负相关。在控制社会支出后，这一相关性减弱；在进一步控制工作时长规制后，该相关性消失。社会支出和工作时长规制均与更低的工作时长相关。

title: Who Pays for Unions?
abstract: If unions raise worker wages, who pays? We provide a comprehensive assessment of firm responses to increased unionization, using changes in the tax deductibility of union dues in Norway as a quasi-exogenous source of variation in firm-level union density. In the average private sector firm, higher union density raises labor costs and leads firms to contract employment and production, lowering profits without increasing the labor share. The incidence is shared: consumers bear part of the cost through higher prices, shareholders through lower profits, and the remainder is offset by productivity improvements. The total wage bill falls, with losses concentrated among less attached “outsider” workers. Firm responses vary systematically by the degree of market competition. In manufacturing, where firms operate in less competitive product and labor markets, the response is reversed: the average firm expands employment and production, reduces labor markdowns, and does not experience profit declines. Instead, higher labor costs are largely passed on to consumers through higher prices, with the remainder offset by productivity gains. Workers benefit as both wages and employment rise. These patterns suggest that unions can offset employer monopsony power and that firm responses—and therefore who ultimately bears the cost—depend importantly on market structure. Overall, unionization in this setting primarily redistributes from consumers rather than shareholders and has effects that differ sharply across firms, including a reallocation toward larger and more productive firms. We rationalize these patterns using a partial-equilibrium model of union bargaining with product- and labor-market power.
title_cn: 谁为工会买单？
abstract_cn: 如果工会提高工人工资，谁来承担成本？我们利用挪威工会会费税收可扣除性的变化，作为企业层面工会密度变化的准外生来源，全面评估了企业对工会化程度上升的反应。在平均私营部门企业中，工会密度上升会提高劳动力成本，并促使企业收缩就业和生产，降低利润，但并未提高劳动收入份额。成本归宿是分担的：消费者通过更高的价格承担一部分成本，股东通过更低的利润承担一部分成本，其余部分则由生产率改善所抵消。总工资支出下降，损失集中在依附程度较低的“局外人”劳动者身上。企业反应因市场竞争程度而存在系统性差异。在制造业中，企业所处的产品市场和劳动力市场竞争程度较低，反应方向相反：平均企业会扩大就业和生产，降低工资向下压低的幅度，并且不会经历利润下降。相反，更高的劳动力成本在很大程度上通过更高的价格转嫁给消费者，其余部分由生产率收益抵消。工人同时因工资和就业上升而受益。这些模式表明，工会可以抵消雇主的买方垄断力量，而企业反应——从而最终由谁承担成本——在很大程度上取决于市场结构。总体而言，在这一情境下，工会化主要从消费者而非股东向劳动者再分配，并且其影响在不同企业之间差异显著，包括向更大、生产率更高的企业再配置。我们用一个包含产品市场和劳动力市场势力的局部均衡工会谈判模型来解释这些模式。

title: A Welfare Analysis of Policies Impacting Climate Change
abstract: We study the welfare impacts of 96 climate-related tax and spending policies. We extend and apply the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) framework, most notably providing a new method for incorporating learning-by-doing spillovers. We find subsidies for the production of clean energy (such as wind production tax credits) have higher MVPFs than all other subsidies in our sample, including EV subsidies. Conservation nudges have large MVPFs when targeting regions with dirty grids. Fuel taxes and cap-and-trade policies are highly efficient means of raising revenue. We also construct traditional cost-per-ton estimates and compare and contrast the lessons they provide. (JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58)
title_cn: 影响气候变化的政策的福利分析
abstract_cn: 我们研究了96项气候相关税收与支出政策的福利影响。我们扩展并应用了公共资金边际价值（MVPF）框架，尤其是提供了一种纳入“干中学”溢出效应的新方法。我们发现，清洁能源生产补贴（如风电生产税收抵免）的MVPF高于样本中所有其他补贴，包括电动汽车补贴。当以电网污染较重的地区为目标时，节能引导措施具有较高的MVPF。燃料税与总量管制和交易政策是筹集收入的高度有效手段。我们还构建了传统的每吨成本估计，并比较和对照了二者所提供的启示。（JEL D83, H23, H25, L62, Q42, Q54, Q58）

title: A Theory of Price Caps on Nonrenewable Resources
abstract: What is the optimal response of a resource exporter when a price cap is imposed on its main export? This paper develops a dynamic framework incorporating stochastic prices, financial frictions, and market power to study this novel tool of statecraft. With the right design, a price cap can incentivize increased extraction, stabilizing prices in the global market. But the stabilizing effects diminish when there is leakage outside the cap. Consequently, weak enforcement of the policy worsens the trade-off faced by the sanctioning policymaker. We provide a systematic approach to setting and enforcing an optimal cap level in these circumstances. (JEL F12, F14, F51, L71, P28, P33, Q35)
title_cn: 不可再生资源价格上限理论
abstract_cn: 当某资源出口国的主要出口品被施加价格上限时，其最优应对是什么？本文构建了一个纳入随机价格、金融摩擦与市场势力的动态框架，以研究这一新型治国工具。若设计得当，价格上限可以激励出口国增加开采，从而稳定全球市场价格。但当价格上限之外存在泄漏时，其稳定效应会减弱。因此，政策执行不力会加剧实施制裁的决策者所面临的权衡。我们提供了一套系统性方法，用于在这些情形下设定并执行最优的价格上限水平。（JEL F12、F14、F51、L71、P28、P33、Q35）

title: Monetary Policy without Commitment
abstract: This paper studies the implications of central bank credibility for long-run inflation and inflation dynamics. We introduce central bank lack of commitment into a standard nonlinear New Keynesian economy with sticky-price monopolistically competitive firms. Inflation is driven by the interaction of lack of commitment and the economic environment. We show that long-run inflation increases following an unanticipated permanent increase in the labor wedge or decrease in the elasticity of substitution across varieties. In the transition, inflation overshoots and then gradually declines. Quantitatively, inflation overshooting is persistent, and the welfare loss from lack of commitment relative to inflation targeting is large. (JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58)

title: Ideological Alignment and Evidence-Based Policy Adoption
abstract: The implementation of evidence-based policies hinges on the dissemination of evidence to policymakers, a process influenced by the attributes of the sender. We conducted a nationwide RCT with ideologically opposite think tanks, major newspapers, and a research institution with nonsalient ideology to communicate a nonideological, cost-effective policy to local policymakers. Results show a 65 percent increase in policy adoption when informing institutions align ideologically with policymakers. We compare the impact of think tanks versus media outlets on implementation, finding both equally effective when ideologically aligned. We explore three actions where ideology may influence adoption: information exposure, belief updating and implementation. (JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23)
title_cn: 意识形态一致性与循证政策采纳
abstract_cn: 基于证据的政策实施取决于证据向政策制定者的传播，而这一过程受到信息发送者特征的影响。我们开展了一项全国性随机对照试验（RCT），由意识形态对立的智库、主要报纸以及一家意识形态不显著的研究机构，向地方政策制定者传播一项非意识形态且成本有效的政策。结果显示，当信息提供机构在意识形态上与政策制定者一致时，政策采纳率提高65%。我们比较了智库与媒体机构对实施的影响，发现两者在意识形态一致时效果相同。我们考察了意识形态可能影响政策采纳的三个环节：信息暴露、信念更新与实施。（JEL C93, D72, D78, D83, I23）

title: Self-Fulfilling Fluctuations in HANK Economies
abstract: We show that in heterogeneous agent New Keynesian (HANK) economies with countercyclical risk, the natural interest rate is endogenous and co-moves with output, leaving the economy susceptible to self-fulfilling fluctuations. Unlike in representative agent New Keynesian models, the Taylor principle is not sufficient to guarantee uniqueness of equilibrium in HANK if risk is even mildly countercyclical: Multiple bounded equilibria exist, no matter how strongly monetary policy responds to changes in inflation. For an active monetary policy to eliminate self-fulfilling fluctuations, it must stabilize the endogenous natural rate fluctuations. Alternatively, a passive monetary and active fiscal regime can also eliminate equilibrium multiplicity. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62)
title_cn: HANK 经济中的自我实现波动
abstract_cn: 我们表明，在风险呈逆周期特征的异质性经济主体新凯恩斯（HANK）经济中，自然利率是内生的，并与产出同向变动，使经济容易受到自我实现波动的影响。与代表性经济主体新凯恩斯模型不同，在HANK中，只要风险哪怕只是轻微逆周期，泰勒原则就不足以保证均衡的唯一性：无论货币政策对通胀变化作出多强的反应，都存在多重有界均衡。要使主动货币政策消除自我实现的波动，它必须稳定内生的自然利率波动。或者，被动货币政策与主动财政政策组合也能消除均衡多重性。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E43, E52, E62）

title: Market Opacity and Fragility: Why Liquidity Evaporates When It Is Most Needed
abstract: Lack of market transparency can impair the liquidity provision of nonstandard liquidity suppliers and make liquidity demand increasing in illiquidity. This can yield strategic complementarities and induce multiple equilibria. Then an initial dearth of liquidity may degenerate into a liquidity rout (as in a “flash crash”), and traders faced with the largest cost of trading are those trading more intensely at equilibrium. An increase in order flow transparency and/or in the mass of dealers who are in the market at all times has a positive impact on total welfare. (JEL G12, G14, G41)
title_cn: 市场不透明性与脆弱性：为何流动性在最需要时蒸发
abstract_cn: 市场缺乏透明度会削弱非标准流动性供给者的流动性提供，并使流动性需求随非流动性上升而增加。这可能产生策略互补性并引致多重均衡。于是，初始的流动性匮乏可能恶化为流动性溃退（如“闪崩”中那样），而在均衡中交易最密集的交易者恰恰面临最高的交易成本。订单流透明度的提高和/或始终在场交易商数量的增加，会对总福利产生正向影响。（JEL G12、G14、G41）

title: Germs in the Family: The Short- and Long-Term Consequences of Intrahousehold Disease Spread
abstract: Preschool-aged children get sick frequently and spread disease to other family members. Despite the universality of this experience, there is limited causal evidence on the magnitudes and consequences of these externalities, especially for infant siblings with developing immune systems and brains. We show in Danish administrative data that during infancy, younger siblings have two to three times higher hospitalization rates for respiratory conditions than older siblings. We combine birth order and within-municipality variation in respiratory disease prevalence among young children, finding lasting differential impacts of early-life respiratory disease exposure on younger siblings' earnings, educational attainment, chronic respiratory health, and mental health-related outcomes. (JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31)
title_cn: 家庭中的病菌：家庭内部疾病传播的短期与长期后果
abstract_cn: 学龄前儿童经常生病，并将疾病传播给其他家庭成员。尽管这种经历具有普遍性，但关于这些外部性的大小和后果的因果证据仍然有限，尤其是对于免疫系统和大脑尚在发育中的婴儿弟妹而言。我们利用丹麦行政数据表明，在婴儿期，弟弟妹妹因呼吸系统疾病住院的比率是哥哥姐姐的两到三倍。我们结合出生顺序与市镇内幼儿呼吸系统疾病患病率的变异，发现生命早期呼吸系统疾病暴露对弟弟妹妹的 earnings、教育获得、慢性呼吸系统健康以及心理健康相关结果具有持久的差异化影响。（JEL D13, D62, I12, J12, J13, J24, J31）

title: The Aggregate Costs of Uninsurable Business Risk
abstract: We use firm-level data to document that private businesses experience large fluctuations in their profit shares. These are due to large, fat-tailed, and transitory changes in output that are not fully accompanied by changes in their inputs. We interpret this evidence using a model of entrepreneurial dynamics. Because firms can limit their exposure to risk by operating at a smaller scale, our model predicts large macroeconomic losses from uninsurable business risk, much larger than those stemming from credit constraints. While self-financing allows entrepreneurs to quickly overcome credit constraints, even wealthy entrepreneurs remain considerably exposed to risk. (JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26)
title_cn: 不可保险的经营风险的总体成本
abstract_cn: 我们使用企业层面数据记录到，私营企业的利润份额经历大幅波动。这些波动源于产出的大幅、厚尾且暂时性的变化，而投入并未随之充分调整。我们用一个企业家动态模型来解释这一证据。由于企业可以通过以较小规模经营来限制其风险暴露，我们的模型预测，不可保险的经营风险会造成巨大的宏观经济损失，远大于信贷约束所造成的损失。尽管自融资使企业家能够迅速克服信贷约束，但即便是富有的企业家仍相当程度地暴露于风险之中。（JEL D33, E02, E44, G32, L25, L26）

title: Understanding High-Wage Firms: Monopoly, Monopsony, and Bargaining Power
abstract: I study how firm market power and worker bargaining power shape wages and welfare. Using French micro-data, I document patterns linking wages and firm market power that existing models cannot explain. A model in which firms produce vertically differentiated goods and share profits with workers explains those patterns. The model (i) reveals new challenges in estimating monopsony and bargaining power, proposing an alternative approach; (ii) shows that the passthrough of firm-specific shocks to wages depends on the type of shock; (iii) explains how markups shape firm wage premia; and (iv) formalizes how strengthening worker bargaining power affects wages and welfare. (JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22)
title_cn: 理解高工资企业：垄断、买方垄断与议价能力
abstract_cn: 我研究企业市场势力和劳动者议价能力如何塑造工资与福利。利用法国微观数据，我记录了工资与企业市场势力之间的关联模式，而现有模型无法解释这些模式。一个企业生产纵向差异化产品并与劳动者分享利润的模型能够解释这些模式。该模型（i）揭示了估计买方垄断和议价能力时面临的新挑战，并提出了一种替代方法；（ii）表明企业特定冲击向工资的传导取决于冲击类型；（iii）解释了加成如何塑造企业工资溢价；（iv）形式化了加强劳动者议价能力如何影响工资与福利。（JEL D22, J31, J42, J52, L12, L22）

title: The Effect of Omitted Variables on the Sign of Regression Coefficients
abstract: We show that, depending on how the impact of omitted variables is measured, it can be substantially easier for omitted variables to flip coefficient signs than to drive them to zero. This behavior occurs with “Oster's delta” (Oster 2019a), a widely reported robustness measure. Consequently, any time this measure is large—suggesting omitted variables may be unimportant—a much smaller value reverses the sign of the parameter of interest. We propose a modified measure of robustness to address this concern. We illustrate our results in four empirical applications and two meta-analyses. We implement our methods in the companion Stata module “regsensitivity.” (JEL C18, C21, C52)
title_cn: 遗漏变量对回归系数符号的影响
abstract_cn: 我们表明，取决于遗漏变量影响的衡量方式，遗漏变量使系数符号反转可能比使其趋于零容易得多。这一现象出现在“Oster's delta”（Oster 2019a）中，该指标是一种被广泛报告的稳健性度量。因此，只要该度量取值较大——表明遗漏变量可能并不重要——一个小得多的取值就会使目标参数的符号反转。我们提出一种修正的稳健性度量以应对这一问题。我们在四个实证应用和两项元分析中展示了我们的结果。我们将方法实现在配套的 Stata 模块“regsensitivity”中。（JEL C18、C21、C52）

title: Skill-Replacing Technology and Bottom-Half Inequality
abstract: I propose a model of skill-replacing routine-biased technological change (SR-RBTC). In this model, technology substitutes for the use of skill in routine tasks, in contrast to standard RBTC models, which assume that technology replaces the workers themselves. The SR-RBTC model explains three key trends that are inconsistent with standard RBTC models: (1) why specifically middle wages declined even though workers in routine occupations are dispersed across the entire bottom half of the wage distribution, (2) why middle wages stopped declining while technological change continued, and (3) why there is no substantial decline in the average wage of workers in routine occupations. I derive two new testable predictions from the model: a decrease in the return to skill and a decrease in skill level in routine occupations. I use an interactive fixed-effects model to confirm both predictions. Since SR-RBTC violates the ignorability assumption required by standard decomposition methods, I introduce a “skewness decomposition” to show that SR-RBTC is the main driver of bottom-half inequality trends.
title_cn: 技能替代技术与下半部分收入不平等
abstract_cn: 我提出一个技能替代型常规偏向技术变革（SR-RBTC）模型。在该模型中，技术替代的是常规任务中技能的使用，而标准RBTC模型则假定技术替代的是劳动者本身。SR-RBTC模型解释了三个与标准RBTC模型不一致的关键趋势：（1）为何恰恰是中等工资下降，尽管常规职业中的劳动者分散在整个工资分布下半部分；（2）为何中等工资在技术变革持续进行的情况下停止下降；（3）为何常规职业劳动者的平均工资没有大幅下降。我从模型中推导出两个新的可检验预测：技能回报下降，以及常规职业中技能水平下降。我使用交互固定效应模型证实了这两个预测。由于SR-RBTC违背了标准分解方法所需的可忽略性假设，我引入“偏度分解”来表明SR-RBTC是下半部分不平等趋势的主要驱动因素。
